tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i zhal gdams mgur 'bum

gyi skor bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ tshad med thugs rje phyogs bcur khyab pa yi/ /ston pa gau tam rgyal ba de la 'dud/ /bde gshegs lam las dpag yas 'gro ba rnams//'dren mdzad kun mkhyen sras la'ang bdag phyag 'tshal/ /'pho 'gyur med pa'i ye shes kyis/ /'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par bzhugs/ /bla ma 'gyur med sku la 'dud/ /gsung mchog grags stong brjod du med/ /rgyal gsung legs bshad rin chen sgron/ /gsung gcig gdul bya thams cad kyi/ /bsam pa dang mtshungs so sor go /thugs ni dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /smon lam dbang gis sprul pa'i sku/ /mdzad pa lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad/ /zhing khams rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur khyod/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rin po che/ /rje btsun bla ma de la 'dud/ /rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /'bral med thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /'khor ba'i chos la blo log cing*/ /gtan gyi 'dun ma byang chub de/ /thob par 'dod na gtam 'di gson/ /'phags pa'i chos kyi bka' mchid yod/ /mi bdag la mos pa'i blo can 'ga'/ /yong srid na yin min thugs la zhog/chos yin nges thugs su 'phrod pa la/ /dad pa dang shes rab kyi las 'phro dgos/ /zad med 'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor bskor nas/ /srid 'dir sdug bsngal myong ba'i mtha' grangs med/ /dka' las dka' dgu myong ste don med yin/ /mtshams med byas pas dmyal ba mnar med du/ /skyes pa'i pha mtha' bgrangs kyang su yis chod/ /rang gis ma bsdad pa yis sa ste ci/ /las stabs 'di ma byas zhes gcig kyang med/ /sdug bsngal ma myong bya ba ga la yod/ /sa phyogs gcig tu chad pas mgo bcad pa'i/ /mgo bo 'ba' zhig spungs par gyur na yang*/ /stong gsum 'jig rten 'di ru ga la shong*/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di la zad pa med/ /dmyal ba'i gnas kyi sdug bsngal bsams gyur na/ /yud tsam gcig kyang bzod skabs ga la yod/

/da lta 'bad na bzlog pa'i thabs mchis kyang*/ /le lo'i ngang la mi tshe skyel lugs 'dis/ /nam zhig dbang med ngan song g.yang sar lhung*/ /de tshe 'gyod kyang 'phyis pa'i dus gcig 'ong*/ /gshin rje'i skyes bus rang lus dum bur gtubs/ /slar yang 'grig nas brgya stong du mar gshags//sha rus rkang gi bar du mes tshig nas/ /yang gsos yang bsreg tshul gyis bskal mang 'das/ khro chu 'bar ba'i gting du 'jug pa dang*/ /lcags kyi thang la lan brgyar bgre ba sogs/ /sdug bsngal bsams na dbang med skyi sha bung*/ /grang bas nyen nas pad ma'i 'dab ltar gas/ /tshe'i tshad ni brgya stong sa ma ya/ /'di la bzod thabs 'dug gam snying med po/ /lo brgya'i bar du zas skom ming yang med/ /'thab rtsod dbang gis rang lus lan brgyar rmas/ /tsha grang sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba yi/ /yi dwags gnas su skyes na ji ltar bgyi// gnas kyi skyabs med gcig la gcig za ba/ /dgra yi 'jigs pas rtag tu skrag cing 'khrul/ /gsod gcod bran du bkol ba'i sdug bsngal can/ /dud 'gro'i tshul la bsams na bzod thabs med/ /mir skyes na yang sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig lags/ /'thab rtsod 'khrugs dang dbul 'phongs brlag pa sogs/ /skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal thob kyang dmyal bar skyes/ /mtho dman 'byor rgud yid brtan ci yang med/ /lha dang lha min gzugs khams gzugs med khams/ /thob kyang yid brtan med par ngan 'gror 'gro/ /'chi 'pho 'thab rtsod la sogs sdug bsngal mang*/ /zhes pa ni sdug bsngal gyi gtam ste dang po'o/ / sdug bsngal de dag thams cad kyang*/ /rgyu med ma yin las las skyes//sdig pa'i dbang gis ngan 'gror 'gro/ /lung ma bstan la rnam smin med/ /dge bas mtho ris 'gro bar gsungs/ /'jig rten las kyi ri mo bkra/ /de bas blang dor la 'bad 'tshal/ /dge sdig chung la'ang brnyas mi bya/

/rnyed dka'i mi lus thob pa la/ /sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo ma skor cig/nam zhig nam 'chi cha med pas/ /dge ba la 'phral du 'bad pa zhu/ /rang la rang dbang med bzhin du/ /'khor g.yog gi mgo 'don a la la/ /dam tshig rtsa ltar bor ba la/ / nyams len gyi khengs gtam bzhad gad bro/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mi mnyes pa'i/ /brtson 'grus kyi 'bad 'bungs a re re/ /che 'dod dang chos brgyad ma zhig pa'i/ /zhen log skad zer te brdzun re che/ /grags 'dod kyi rlung dmar ma zhi ba'i/ /dben pa 'grims pas ci la phan/ /rang gzhan gyi phyogs ris je 'phel la/ /sgrub pa byed skad de zog rgan yin/ /'phral jo bzang mi gshis legs legs 'dra/ /phugs su gyod sbyor de phung rgan yin/ /chos pa'i rnam thar gtsang ba de/ /ci byed chos dang mthun pa yin/ /chos brgyad kyi 'khor lo bskor ba de/ /'gro don skad zer kyang the le le/ /drin can pha ma mi 'dren par/ /zhi bde don gnyer gyis ga la 'ong*/ /g.yo can drang gtam gyis slu ba la/ mi shes klad med kun chu ltar rgyug /gting skyon 'don pa'i gtam ste gnyis pa'o/ /mtha' yas dus kyi bskal pa la'ang*/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba brgya lam tsam/ /skye ba 'bum phrag du ma la'ang*/ /mi lus thob pa lan re tsam/ /mi lus ma thob pa'i skye ba gzhan/ /las 'bras la spang blang byed pa dkon/ /dam chos kyi nyams len ga la zhig /dam chos rna bar yang mi 'gro ba'i/ /bza' btung longs spyod sgrub la mkhas pa de/ /dud 'gro dang khyad par cung zad med/ /dam chos nyams su ma blangs na/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba yin/ /rang sems 'dul thabs lam 'bad na/ /'khor ba la rang thar mi yong ste mchi/ /dus da res bla ma dang mjal dus 'dir/ /'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba zhu/ /mi lus thob kyang chos dang mjal/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad bsten/ /gdams ngag zab dgu thob dus 'dir/ /nyams len mi byed na rang la sdig

/mi nor chen ser snas bcings pa zhig /nor longs spyod kyis bang mdzod mang yod kyang*/ /za ma nus ltogs nas shi ba bzhin/ /nyams len cung zad kyang mi byed pa'i/ /chos sna mang po bsags pa ste/ /dpe bum gyis mdzod phug bkang na yang*/ /rang rgyud tha mal du lus shing 'chi/ /dgos dus phan pa mi 'byung ngo*/ /'dus byas mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba dang*/ /nyin mtshan sdod med kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /nyi zla gza' skar gyi 'char nub 'di/ /dus sdod med du ston pa'i slob dpon lags/ /gzhan shi ba mthong dang thos pa dang*/ /'phral nad kyis btab dang rgas pa sogs/ /rgyal khams dang yul mi'i 'gyur lugs kun/ /cis kyang 'chi ba'i bya gtong yin/ / rgan gzhon dang drag gzhan gyi dbye ba med/ /kun gyis bkur ba'i rgyal po dang*/ /shin tu gces pa'i grogs dang bu/ /gzugs bzang nad med dpa' rtsal 'dzom/ /'khor dmag dpung 'dzom pa'i kha drag po/ /zad med longs spyod kyi dbus na nyal ba yang*/ /nam zhig 'chi ba la thug pa'i tshe/ /thabs cis kyang phan pa mi gdog pas/ /bsags pa'i nor dang mdza' ba'i grogs/ /'tsho ba'i zas dang snyan pa'i gtam/ /thams cad dbang med shul du lus/ /'chi bdag rgyal pos zin pa la/ /g.yo sgyu dang thabs kyis mi zlog cing*/ /nor rdzas dang dbang thang gis ci byar yod/ /nam zhig 'byung bzhi'i phung po 'di/ /nam 'gyes kyi dus btab mi gdog pas/ /'phral 'phral du dam chos la ma 'bad na/ /shin tu 'gyod par gyur ta re/ /lang tsho yol bar ma gyur zhing*/ /nad kyi ma btab dbang po gsal/ /skad cig kyang sdod pa'i dbang med par/ /smra 'phro la shi ba ma mthong ngam/ /spyir nges par 'chi dang myur du 'chi/ /nam 'chi cha med kyi long med bsam/ /cis kyang mi phan pa'i nges 'byung bskyed/ /blo chos su 'gro ba'i gdams ngag lags/ /mi lus rnyed par dka' zhing mi rtag pa'i gtam ste gsum pa'o/

/rnyed dka' don chen thob dus 'dir/ /slu ba med pa'i las 'bras la/ /spang blang 'khrul pa med par 'tshal/ /mchog dman kun la gdams ngag yin/ /dge sdig gi las la spyad pa ni/ /bde sdug gi 'bras bu rgya cher 'phel/ /nas bre gang sbyin par btang ba yang*/ /zhing bsam pa rnam par dag gyur na/ /gnas mtho ris su skye ba dpag med par/ /bde skyid kyi 'bras bu bsam mi khyab/ /las nyin gcig bsags pa'i sdig la'ang*/ /lo grangs med dmyal bar sdug bsngal myong*/ /gzhan skye ba brgya stong dud 'gro dang*/ /yi dwags kyi gnas su khar ma 'khor/ /rgya la mi ru skyes kyang 'phongs pa dang*/ /tshe thung la sogs sdug bsngal zad pa med/ /dge ba las sdug bsngal myong ba dang*/ /sdig pa las bde skyid 'byung ba ni/ /gang na'ang srid pa ma yin pas/ /phra mo nas zhib tig gal re che/ /stong nyid kyi rbad kham ma che ang*/ /bdag nyid sdig pas ma gos na/ khams gsum gyi sems can dgrar langs kyang*/ /ngan song du 'khrid pa'i go skabs med/ /bdag rang gis byas pa ma yin par/ /phan pa'i dge ba dang gnod pa'i sdig /rang ci 'dod spo thabs mi gdog cing*/ /las ma byas pa dang 'phrad pa med/ /dus bskal pa 'bum phrag brgya 'das kyang*/ /lam bsgoms shing sbyong thabs ma byas na/ /las rnying nas chud zos 'gyur ba sogs/ /don med du zad pa yong mi srid/ /de ltar 'phel ba che dang 'bras bu des/ /ma byas 'phrad med byas pa chud mi gson/ /mtshan nyid bzhi dang ldan phyir dge sdig gi /las la spang blang byed pa gal re che/ /rang sems bdag tu 'dzin pas bcings pa las/ /nyon mongs dug gsum gyi 'char sgo 'byung*//dug gsum gyi rnam rtog rgya yan gyis/ /las byas tshad sdug bsngal g.yos su mthong*/ /'bad nas sgrubs pa'i dge ba yang*/ /mthar 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /las gzhan lta smos kyang ga la dgos/ /dus da res gtan gyi mdun ma sgrubs/

/nyon mongs pas las bsags sdug bsngal myong*/ /ma dag 'khor ba'i snang ba shar/ /dar gyi srin bu ji bzhin du/ /rang gis rang nyid bcings nas ni/ /nam yang thar pa med pa yin/ /sdug bsngal dpag med myong ba lags/ /rang sems rang gnas su ma chug pas/ /gcig la chags shing gcig la sdang*/ /gnas lugs ma rtogs mgo bo 'khor/ /nyon mongs gang skyes kyang rang sems yin/ /las ni nyon mongs kyis gsog pa'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo bskor ba 'di'i/ /rtsa ba ni rang gi sems las byung*/ /grol yang rang gi sems su grol/ /las dang 'bras bu'i gtam ste bzhi pa'o/ /'khor ba'i gnas tshul de lags pas/ /zad med kyi sdug bsngal bzlog pa dang*/ /dus gtan du bde ba'i go 'phang zhig/da res cis kyang thob par 'tshal/ /lta ba dang spyod pa bsgom pa gsum/ /'dzom zhing lag len la thebs pa dgos/ /dpe mdung sgrom bzhag pa ji bzhin du/ /de gsum gcig la gcig brten lags/ /lta med kyi spyod pa bzang na yang*/ /mtshan 'dzin 'khor ba'i rgyu zhig lags/ /spyod pa nyams pa'i lta ba ni/ /bsod nams tshogs kyang ma rdzogs la/ /chad lta'i g.yang la lhung nyen yod/ /sgom pa med na lta spyod kyang*/ /sa 'og gter bzhin phan mi thogs/ /ji ltar dbul po'i khyim gyi 'og /ta la bdun srid tsam zhig na/ /mi zad rin chen gter yod kyang*/ dbul po bkres pas ngal ba bzhin/ /lta spyod bzang po mang bshad kyang*/ /sgom pas sgrub pa dang bral ba la/ /sems dang chos su ma 'dres pas/ /dgos dus phan thog 'byung ba dka'/ /sangs rgyas sems can gyi spyi mes des/ /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /tshul khrims shes rab sems zhes pa'i/ /bslab pa rnam gsum gsungs pa yin/ /tshul khrims kyi bslab pa spyod pa ste/ /shes rab kyi bslab pa lta ba yin/ /sgom pa sems kyi bslab pa ste/ /bslab gsum 'di la nan tan 'tshal/ /lta ba'i rgyal po mtha' bral ste/

/yod 'dzin rtag pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /med 'dzin chad pa'i mtha' dang bral/ /cir yang mi 'dzin dbu ma'i lam/ /ya gi zhig rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas/ /ma gi dmyal khams yan chad du/ /phyi sa rdo ri brag 'jig rten dang*/ /nang phung po khams dang dbang po sogs/ /'gro drug srog chags su snang ba dang*/ /yul gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos/ /thams cad rang sems kyi snang ba tsam/ /phyi rol na med kyang yod par snang*/ /'di ltar snang ba thams cad ni/ /phyi na med cing nang na'ang med/ /yul dang sems su grub pa med/ /ji ltar smyo ba'i 'khrul snang la/ /don la dgra bo med na yang*/ /dgra bos rang nyid 'ded par snang*/ /de dgra bor snang ba sems snang yin/ /phyi ru med par ma zad kyi/ /'khrul bas dgra bor snang ba ltar/ /sems kyi ngo bor yang ga la grub/ /gzugs gdod nas grub pa med pa'i phyir/ /rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba la/ /gzugs kyi rnam par snang mod kyi/ /gzugs phyin med par ma zad kyi/ /sems kyi ngor yang ga la grub/ /ri bong mgo la rwa med na/ /rmi lam du ri bong rwa rmi yang*/ /de 'khrul pa tsam gyi snang ngo las/ /phyi nang gang na'ang yod ma yin/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad de/ /'khor ba gdod nas stong par ma zad kyi/ /lam gyi 'char sgo sna tshogs dang*/ /'bras bu dag snang rab 'byams kyang*/ /thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin/ /sems kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ /nam yang 'gyur ba mi srid cing*/ /gang la'ang phyogs cha nye ring bral/ kha dog dbyibs sogs mtshan nyid med/ /bltar med gzung du med pa la/ /ji ltar byas kyang shong ba dang*/ /snod bcud thams cad 'char du rung*/ /yod med gang du'ang brjod mi nus/ /rin chen sems kyi rgyal po 'di/ /ci yang ma yin dmigs su med/ /chos rnams gang gi'ang mtshan nyid du/ /'di ltar yod ces brjod du med/ /'khor ba snod bcud 'jig rten dang*/ /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal sogs/

/dad pa snying rje stong nyid sgom/ /sa dang lam gyi rim pa dang*/ /nyams rtogs yon tan 'char sgo dang*/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje dang*/ /ye shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs dang*/ /'phrin las rgyun chad med par snang ba ste/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'char sgo zad med 'di/ /rang sems gcig pu'i snang bar shar/ /de phyir med ces mi brjod do/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar/ / sems kyi rang bzhin gsal stong ste/ /ngan song dmyal bar skyes dus kyang*/ /ngo bo ngan du ma song zhing*/ /nam zhig rdzogs sangs rgyas dus su/ /ngo bor bzang por 'gyur ba med/ /gsal cha rgyun mi 'chad phyir med pa min/ /ye nas ngos bzung med phyir yod pa min/ /gnyis ka ma yin gnyis ka min pa'ang min/ /de dag ma yin gzhan yang ma yin pas/ /rang sems 'di la 'di yin brjod du med/ / brjod med bsam med dbyings la mnyam par bzhag /lta ba gtso bor gyur pa'i gtam ste lnga pa'o/ /rang bzhin lta ba rnam dag de/ /spyod pa'i grogs dang sbrel bar bya//dkar nag las 'bras kyi phra zhib la/ /blangs dor nan tan du 'bad pa dang*/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa srog bzhin bsrungs/ /dam du bcas shing khas blangs pa'i/ /dge ba nan tan du sgrub pa gces/ /gang bsten na dam chos 'phel ba dang*/ /dge la sbyor zhing blo mthun la/ /chog shes ldan zhing ci byed kyang*/ /sgo gsum chos dang mthun pa ste/ /mtho dman ji ltar yin na yang*/ / grogs bzang de 'dra rnyed na bsten/ /da lta dus kyi skyon kho nas/ /de'i 'dra'i grogs bzang rnyed dka' bas/ /gcig pu dben par gnas par bya//chos kyi bar chad byed pa dang*/ /sdig pa'i las la sbyor ba yi/ /grogs ngan ring du spang bar bya/ /grogs su zhig yin yang tshe 'di yi/ /che 'dod dang snang shas chags sdang sogs/ /je 'phel du 'gro bar 'dug na ni/ /lung pa gcig tu'ang mi sdod de/

/rgyang ring pha rol 'gro ba mchog /chos byed nyams len 'phel ba'i sa/ /gnas chen yin pas yun ring sdod/ /chags sdang dang phyogs 'dzin 'phel ba der/ /grub thob gong ma'i bzhugs gnas sam/ /dge 'dun gyi sde'am chos kyi grwa/ /bla ma'i gdan sa yin na yang*/ /mi sdod dben pa'i gnas su 'gro/ /phyag dang skor ba la sogs pa/ /lus kyi dge ba ci 'grub bya//mi lus thob pa la mdo don yod pa yin/ /mdo 'don gsol 'debs sngags bzlas sogs/ /ngag gi dge ba ci nus bya/ /ngag nus pa rnyed pa'i phan yon yod/ /lha sgom dang dad pa yi rang sogs/ /yid kyi dge ba la 'bad par bya/ /sems ting 'dzin la rang byang chub nas 'ong*/ /dgos med brel ba'i yal yul dang*/ /long gtam zad med kyi smra brjod dang*/ /sems mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu'i rnam rtog mkhan/ /lus dben par bsdad kyang mdo med yin/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor mi lus 'di/ /sos dal du ma gtong chos la 'bungs/ /mchod dang gtor ma la brtson pa dang*/ /yon gnas kyi zhing mchog dge 'dun dang*/ /sku gzugs dang mchod rten la mchod bgyid cing*/ /dbul 'phongs rnams la sbyin pa gtong*/ / kun 'dus kyi bla ma rin po che/ /mnyes par byed cing ci gsung sgrub/ /mtha' yas 'gro drug gi sems can rnams/ /yi dam du bsgom zhing gus par byed/ /pha mar bsgom zhing phan 'dogs na/ /mched grogs kyi dag snang lta ci smos/ / sems can dang bstan pa la gnod 'dug na/ /rang gi don chen ci yin yang*/ / de ma thag tu bor ba gces/ /dkon mchog la smod pa'i rgyur 'gyur dang*/ / bshad sgrub kyi chos grwa la gnod pa dang*/ /dge 'dun sde 'khrugs kyi rgyur song na/ /rang gi ched du ma bsams kyang*/ /sdig pa'i phung po mu mtha' med//bskal pa grangs med du dmyal bar gnas/ /ched du bsams la smos ci dgos/ /pha bsad nas ma la mchod byas kyang*/ /dge bar 'gyur ba ga la yod//gzhan gyi bstan pa la gnod byas nas/

/rang bstan pa 'dzugs zer a tsa ma/ /bdag nyid spyod pa phun tshogs kyang*/ /gzhan la brnyas pa mi 'tshal zhing*/ /spyod pa la bzang du mi 'dzin par/ /blang dor du snang ba ji snyed kyang*//thams cad sgyu ma'i rang snang tsam/ /las 'bras kyang rmi lam ltar shes pas/ /ci byed dran pa'i so bas bzung*/ /blang dor ro mnyam gyi ngang du zhog/spyod pa'i skabs kyi gtam ste drug pa'o/ /lta ba mtha' dbus med pa dang*/ /spyod pa blang dor bral ba zhig /

sgom pa yengs med kyis nyams su long*/ /nges par don du 'gyur te mchi/ / sems rang rig rang gsal so ma la/ /bcas bcos mi bya rang dgar bzhag /tshogs drug gi snang ba 'gag med la/ /lhug pa'i ngang nas rang so bzung*/ /gang shar la ngo shes rjen pa 'tshal/ /gang shar rang ngo ma shes na/ / stong nyid mi rtog pa'i sgom pa yang*/ /blo byas kyi chos las ma 'das pas/ /rtag kyang mi thub ku re dog /ma bcos klong du gyur pa'i tshe/ /spros bcas kyi sgom pa ci byas kyang*/ /rang ngo shes pa'i gnad mchog des/ /ci byas byar med kyi dbyings su thim/ /snang ba dang rnam rtog ci shar yang*/ kho rang gi rang ngo shes dus na/ /gsal stong brjod med blo las 'das/ /rang zhal rjen par lhang gis mthong*/ /sems rang bzhin stong gsal bde ba de/ /rkyen gyis 'byung ba ma yin la/ /bla ma gdams ngag mkhas nas yin/ /slob ma shes rab ches pas min/ /gzhi nas dngos po'i gnas lugs lags/ /yin pa la yin par ngo shes 'tshal/ /dran pa rgyun chags mchog tu gces/ /bla ma sangs rgyas rin chen la/ /yid mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems/ /spros bral nam mkha' lta bu gnyis/ /gcig tu 'dres la gsol ba thob/ /rang sems chos sku'i rang mtshang rig /rang lus lha skur shes par bya/ /dag snang rab 'byams mched pa yin/ /'gro drug pha mar shes par bya/ /snying rje mkha' ltar khyab pa yin/ /snang ba sgyu mar shes par bya/ /'dzin pa rang sar grol bar 'gyur/ /rang sems skye med du shes par bya/ /'gyur med kyi btsan sa zin pa lags/ /gzung ba phyi ru ma lus shing*/ /'dzin pa nang du ma lus par/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis spangs kyi shes pa de/ /rig stong dbyer med chos kyi sku/ /ji ltar chu la chu blug dang*/ /ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin/ /snang sems gcig tu bsre ba la/ /dran dang shes bzhin gyis skyong bar 'tshal/ /sgom pa'i skabs kyi gtam ste bdun pa'o/

/sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa dang*/ /brtson 'grus bsam gtan lnga po yang*/ /dmigs med kyis zin na phar phyin yin/ /shes rab nyid la lta ci smos/ /gong lta spyod sgom par bshad pa de/ /nyams su blangs na phar phyin drug /thams cad de kar 'dus pa yin/ /mchod gtor sbyin pa ci 'grub brtson/ /nyes spyod sdig las kun tu bzlog /ci byed gzhan don gyi tshul khrims can/ /chos phyir dka' spyad bzod pa dang*/ /gzhan gyi gnod pa bzod par bya/ /nyin mtshan g.yel med brtson 'grus dang*/ /rtse gcig sems kyis bsam gtan sgrub/ /spros bral shes pa'i shes rab ste/ /thams cad dmigs med kyis rgyas thebs dgos/ /pha rol du phyin pa drug po yi/ /sgrub pa nyams len gzhan yod min/ /sbyin pas sems can mgu bar bya/ /chos gdams ngag blo dang 'tsham par ston/ /chos bzhin nyams len byed du gzhug /rang yang chos dang mthun par spyod/ /sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang*/ /don mthun pa dang don gcig spyod/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi zhes pa/ /gzhan don sgrub pa'i chos su gsungs/ /lar rang sems la rang gis sgom pa 'di/ /shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa yin/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor yin/ /snang grags kun la gdod ma nas/ /rgyas btab phyag rgya chen po yin/ /'khor 'das gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /sems kyi rgyal po ma go na/ /chos byas pa rnams kyang lha mi'i rgyur/ /da stong nyid mthar thug yin snyam yang*/ /gzugs med khams su gol nye gdog /lus ngag gi spyod pa zab lags kyang*/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi bu//tsitta snying gi gur khang du/ /rin chen bla ma bsgoms nas kyang/ /mos gus la ltem 'gyang mi 'tshal te/ /rang sems la lta zhing mnyam par zhog /byams snying rje rgyun mi 'chad par sgoms/ /dbyings stong pa dang rig pa dbyer med pas//rnam rtog dang mi rtog dgag sgrub med/ /snang ba dang stong pa dbyer med pas/

/nyon mongs dang ye shes spang blang med/ /bdag gzhan dang bzang ngan dbyer med pas/ /lha dang 'dre la spangablang med/ /'khor ba dang myang 'das dbyer med pas/ /bde sdug la dgag sgrub ga la dgos/ khyed spang blang mi bya phyag chen sgoms/ /mnyam nyid ro snyoms kyi ngang la zhog /du ma ro gcig gi ngang du gnas/ /re dogs med par bskyur la thong*/ /bdag gzung med par bor la zhog /rang sems dang chos dbyings dbye ba med/ /shi gson la khyad par mi gda'o/ /gzhi dad pa 'gyur ba med pa de/ /yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /rang 'dod ma 'khris pa'i gzhan don de/ /theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba yin/ /cis kyang dgos med kyi zhen log 'di/ /blo chos su 'gro ba'i rtsa ba yin/ /nyams myong rtogs pa dang dad pa de/ /nyams len mkhan la dgos pa yin/ /rkyen gang byung ro snyoms thub pa de/ /bogs 'don mkhan la dgos pa yin/ /sgyu ma'i nyams snang shar tsam na/ /chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog nub pa snyam//chu la mi 'bying mes mi 'tshig /tsha grang sdug bsngal med snyam sogs/ gzhan yang yon tan brgyad la sogs/ /yon tan than thun skyes pa'i tshe/ /nga rgyal snyems byed kyi bdud byung nas/ /sgom thur du 'bab pa'i nyen gdog pas/ /bzang 'dzin dang dga' sems ci dgar bor/ /rmi lam la dga' ba'i sgom chen de/ /gnyis 'dzin gyi sgrog tu chud pa yin/ /che 'dod kyi yon tan la dga' ba de/ /g.yeng ba'i rlung gis khyer ba yin/ /sgom pa tshogs su tshud pa na//rtsol med kyi dbyings su ngang gis 'jug /sangs rgyas dang 'khor ba'i bar shed na/ /rig pa skad cig ma'i khyad par yod/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i snang ba kun/ /rang ngo ma shes pa'i sems snang yin/ /sems kyi skad cig don kun rig /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de la zer/ /ye shes gcig pu'i rang snang la/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ru btags/ /rang bzhin stong nyid mtha' bral la/ /chos kyi sku zhes rab tu bsgrags/

/sems de'i gsal cha 'gag med du/ /mtshan dpe dag pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ /rgyun 'chad med par snang ba ni/ /thub pa'i longs spyod rdzogs skur 'gyur/ /rang bzhin ma rtogs pa'i sems can la/ /snying rje mkha' ltar khyab pa'i phyir/ /gang la gang 'dul thabs su ston/ /rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku ru shes/ /cig car shes bya kun mkhyen yang*/ /de dang de la der 'dzin med/ /rgyun mi 'chad cing kun la khyab/ /me long gzugs brnyan 'dra bas na/ /'di ni me long ye shes yin/ /chos rnams mnyam pa nyid mthong bas/ /bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i thugs rje can/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes yin/ /chags thogs med par dngos kun gyi/ /rang bzhin gsal la ma 'das pa/ /gzigs pa med pa'i tshul gyis gzigs/ /so sor rtog pa'i ye shes yin/ /rnam par rtog med lhun grub par/ /'gro don phyogs med 'byung ba ste/ /bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes ni/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dra ba yin/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ni/ /phyogs lhung med cing rgyar ma chad/ /brjod bral dbyings kyi sems nyid de/ /ye shes thams cad 'di las byung*/ /sems ni dri mar bcas pa'i tshe/ /las nyon sdug bsngal zad med snang*/ /sems las byung zhing sems la thim/ /rnal 'byor lam la gnas pa'i tshe/ /dag dang ma dag 'dres pa na/ /lus ngag yid kyi nyams dang rtsal/ /sems snang gi yon tan ji snyed pa/ /sems las skyes nas sems su 'gag /sems nyid shin tu rnam dag tshe/ /sangs rgyas zhes byar ming thogs te/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga dang ni//yon tan 'phrin las zad med pa/ /sems kyi rang rtsal rgyun chad med/ /sems can byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya rnam gsum po/ /sems nyid gcig pu'i ming 'dogs yin/ /sems nyid gtan la phebs pa'i tshe/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum gtan la phebs/ /dam chos kyi rgyal po phyag rgya che/ /gcig shes kun grol la nan tan 'tshal/

/bdag cag phyogs med ris med kyi/ /rnal 'byor tā ra nā tha la/ /dad pa dang skal par ldan pa yi/ /grogs dang slob mas bskul ba'i ngor/ /mtha' yas tshig gi spros pa spangs/ /sdeb sbyor legs khrigs la ma bltas par/ /nyams len zab mo'i gnad bskul gtam/ /mdor bsdus bris nas phul ba lags// // ༄༅/ /lta sgom spyod gsum gyi gdams pa mdo sngags lam gyi snying po bzhugs/ / na mo gu ru/ bde chen chos sku nam mkha' dag pa la/ /mtha' dag srid gsum snang ba ci yang shar/ /zung 'jug gdod ma'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ /bla ma mchog la dngos po kun gyis 'dud/ /brjod med rang rig don dam rtogs pa'i thabs/ /dad ldan slob mas bskul phyir 'dir brjod bya/ /nges pa'i don ni tshig gi yul min yang*/ /brda la brten nas don dam rtogs par 'gyur// dngos po'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa'i phyir/ /'khrul med lta ba'i nges gsang rtogs par bya/ /gnas lugs bzhin du nyams su myong ba'i phyir// nyams len sgom pa'i gnad la 'khrul med dgos/ /rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i phyir/ /lag len spyod pa rnam par dag pa gces//gzhi'i gnas lugs ji bzhin mngon gyur pa/ /rgyu 'bras dbyer med 'bras bu mngon gyur gnad/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba med dang spros bral dang*//lhan cig skyais dang rang rig rang gsal dang*/ /kun khyab mtha' bral brjod med ces pa ste/ /gnas lugs lta ba'i gnad bdun rig par bya/ /'jig rten srid pa chags 'jig ci byung yang*/ /mkha' la yangs dog med cing 'gyur ba med/ 'khor 'das bde sdug mtho dman thams cad la/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bzang ngan 'pho 'gyur med/ /snang ba ci yang 'char bas med pa min/ /rang bzhin ngos gzung bral phyir yod pa min/ /gdod nas ci yang min pa'i rang bzhin la/ /blo yis bzhag pa'i spros pa kun dang bral/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs sems kyi rang bzhin 'di//

gsar byung ma yin gdod nas lhan cig skyes/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum yang*/ /tha snyad tsam las rang bzhin tha dad med/ /cang med ma yin rig stong ma 'gags pas/ /gsal la ngos bzung med cing gtad so bral/ 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i snang ba kun/ /rtag tu 'char zhing shar dus nyid nas stong*// nam mkha' rang bzhin stong pa tsam 'di la/ /shar nub la sogs phyogs cha nye ring med/ /ka ba'i nam mkha' bum pa'i nam mkha' zhes/ /tshig tsam yin gyi sus kyang 'byed mi nus//de phyir sems kyang mkha' ltar kun tu khyab/ /nyams len ma byas 'khrul pa'i sems nyid dang*/ /lam gyi gnas skabs rnal 'byor pa yi sems/ /'khrul snang dag pa rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sems/ /ming 'dogs tha dad don la khyad par med/ /cir yang 'char la ci yang ma yin pa/ /stong gsal ngos bzung bral ba gcig pu la/ /'khrul pas so sor btags pa kho na lags/ /gang du'ang gzung rgyu med pas mtha' dang bral/ /dngos por 'dzin na rtag pa'i mtha' yin la/ /stong par 'dzin na chad pa'i mtha' zhes gsungs/ /gang du'ang ma grub phyir na blo las 'das/ /bzang ngan dngos po dngos med 'dus byas dang*/ /'dus ma byas sogs snang zhing grags pa yi/ /ming dang tha snyad ji tsam brjod kyang rung*/ /dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /sdod lugs ji bzhin brjod par mi nus pas/ /tshig gi lam las 'das shing brjod bral yin/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog gi byin rlabs kyis/ /rang rig tsam gyis nyams su myong bya lags/ /grub mtha' tha dad sna tshogs lta ba'i don/ /kun dang 'di nyid mthun zhing kun las lhag /gzhan rnams gnas lugs phyogs re tsam la spyod/ /gdod ma'i gnas tshul 'khrul med 'di kho na/ /nyan thos pa rnams gang zag bdag med sgom/ /rang rgyal gzung ba'i yul rnams bden med dang*//rnal 'byor spyod pa gnyis stong ye shes dang*/ /dbu ma pa rnams chos kun bden med zer/

/gsang sngags phyi ba snang stong lha yi sku/ /bla med pa rnams bde stong dbyer med de/ /thams cad rang sems gcig pu'i ming 'dogs yin/ rang sems gcig pu gtan la 'bebs pa yin/ /bya byed byed po kun dang bral ba'i phyir/ /gang zag bdag med ces pa sems 'di nyid/ /yul snang thams cad sems nyid gcig pu'i rtsal/ /de phyir gzung ba chos kyi bdag med yin/ /chu rlabs chu dang dbye ba med pa bzhin/ /snang ba thams cad rang sems gcig pu'i rtsal/ /de phyir gzung dang 'dzin pa'i dbye ba med/ /rang bzhin gsal stong rgyun chad med pa 'di/ /gnyis med ye shes don dam gnas lugs yin/ /gtad so med cing dmigs su med pa dang*/ /gzung med brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i phyir/ nam yang yod ma myong ba'i chos nyid yin/ /'khor 'das kun gyi rnam par 'char ba dang*/ /shar tsam nyid nas stong pas gsal stong yin/ mi rtag sdug bsngal la sogs tha snyad tsam/ /don la ngo bo ma grub brag cha bzhin/ /rang bzhin mi 'gyur bde ba chen po la/ /gang yang 'dzin du med pas bde stong yin/ /lta ba'i rgyal po mtha' bral nam mkha'i dpe/ /gnas lugs zab mo thugs la nges par 'tsham/ de dag lta ba'i gnas tshul mdo tsam mo/ /lta ba mkha' ltar yangs pa ste/ /sgom par nyams su myong ba gces//nyams myong med pa'i lta ba ni/ /yid dpyod go ba tsam la lus/ /las dang po yi rnal 'byor pas/ /rjes thob gnyug ma'i ye shes la/ /rang ngo 'phrod pa dka' ba'i phyir/ /zhi lhag gnyis la 'bad pa gces/ /sems kyi gnas thabs dgu la sogs/ /zhi gnas sgom pa'i rim pa dang*/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /lhag mthong la sogs rnam gzhag mang*/ kho bo snying po la dga' bas/ /spros pa du ma 'dir mi 'chad/ /zab mo'i de nyid nyams myong dang*/ /rjes su 'brel ba mdo tsam ni/ /dpyad 'jog spel mar sgom pa sogs/ /gzhung lugs rnams las mang bshad pa/ /de yang lam du 'gyur mod kyi/

/man ngag can la 'di mi dgos/ /rang bzhin gdod nas spros bral la/ /de ltar yin par ngo shes pa'i/ /thabs kyi rgyal po zla med pa/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i mos gus yin/ /rang gi sems kyis rang sems la/ /rang dbang 'byor phyir zhi gnas sgom/ /rang bzhin gdod nas spros bral la/ /thag chod skye phyir sems 'tshol bya/ /gtan la phebs pa'i rang sems de/ /ngo shes gcig pus chog pa'i phyir/ /dran pa 'bral med rgyun du bsten/ /dran pa med la ngo shes dka'/ /gnas lugs gdod ma yin pa'i phyir/ /ma bcos so ma gnad du che/ /gang shar gnyug ma yin pa'i phyir/ /lhug par 'jog pa sgom gyi gnad/ /bya byed nyams len thams cad kyi/ /mthar phyin byed pa bogs 'don gnad/ /bla ma chos skur mthong ba yi/ /mos gus byin rlabs lam byed de/ /sgom pa nyams su len pa yin/ /gnad mchog bdun po bla ma'i gsung*/ /nyams len mtha' ru skyong ba la/ med thabs med pa'i gal po che/ /bying rgod gnyis kyis ma slad pa'i/ /rang sems gsal stong 'dzin med ni/ /btang 'gro bzhag sdod rang dbang 'byor//zhi gnas sgom gyi rtsa ba yin/ /bying na sgrim zhing ngar cha 'don/ / rgod na slod la lta stangs phab/ /thun mtshams spyod lam ci byed kyang*/ /gnas pa'i rang so 'dzin pa gces/ /lha sku thig le la sogs pa/ /dmigs pa'i rnam gzhag gang gsungs kyang*/ /rten med rig pa sgom med du/ /'jog pa kho na zab par 'khums/ /rang sems la rang sems kyis bltas pas/ /gsal la brjod bral ngos gzung med par 'khums/ /kun rdzob gzugs dang kha dog gnas dang dus/ /btsal bas ma rnyed gdod ma'i gnas lugs mthong*/ /de tshe rang sems stong gsal chos kyi sku/ /rgyun du yod kyang sngon chad ma shes pa/ /ngo shes rgyun chad med pa dgos pas na/ /rtag tu dran pas skyong ba gnad du che/ /dran bya dran byed dbyings su ma dag par/ /dran pa skyes dus rang zhal lta shes kyis/

/dran pa nyams tshe tha mal pa dang 'dra/ /ngo shes dran pa'i rtsa bar thug pa yin/ /ngo shes med pa'i gnas pa gti mug yin/ /rang ngo shes nas rnam rtog chos kyi sku/ /shes na thams cad chos sku'i yo langs te/ /min na thams cad spros pa'i mgo skor yin/ /chu dang mar me rang gsal gcig tu zhog /bram ze chen pos de skad gsungs pa bzhin/ /ma bcos so ma nyams len sgom gyi mthil/ /bcos ma'i nyams myong bzang yang na bun 'dra/ /rig pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid sgom pa dang*/ ril 'dzin rjes gzhig spro bsdu'i stong nyid dang*/ /lha sgom sngags bzlas sogs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ /rtsa yi rnal 'byor sgoms pa'i stong nyams dang*//rlung gi gdam ngag bsgoms pa'i gsal ba dang*/ /thig le bsgoms pa'i bde ba'i ye shes dang*/ /rtag snang 'char sgo sna tshogs 'byung ba rnams/ /thams cad rkyen la ltos shing glo bur ba/ /rdzas sngags 'dzom pas mig 'phrul mthong ba bzhin/ /rgyu rkyen 'dzom tshe 'byung la gzhan mi 'byung*/ /mi brtan mi rtag 'phel 'grib yal yol byed/ /gdod ma ma yin 'phral du skye zhing 'jig

/ma bcos gnyug ma'i nyams len gyis zin na/ /de dag kun yang 'gyur med chos kyi sku/ /blos byas bsgom de ji ltar bzang na yang*/ /gsog gsob snying po med pa ya ma rla//bzang por ming btags gnyen por bcos pa dang*/ /rnam rtog 'khrul pas sna tshogs bcos pa 'di/ /mkha' la na bun sprin gyis sgrib pa bzhin/ /gnas lugs rang zhal blta ba'i bar chad yin/ /gser gyi thig po gser du bsgyur mi dgos/ / snang grags thams cad rang bzhin spros bral la/ /thabs kyis gsar du spros pa bcos mi dgos/ /rang bzhin de la bzo bcos med par bzhag /rtog med rang ngo shes shing sems gnas na/ /mkha' dbyings lta bu'i ngang der lhan ne sgaum/ /bzang ngan rnam rtog ji ltar shar na yang*/ /de la bzo bcos med par lhug par bzhag /nyon mongs skyes kyang gang skyes gsal stong yin/ /nges 'byung snying rje skyes kyang gsal stong yin/ /gang skyes gang shar thams cad ro gcig la/ /spang blang dgag sgrub byed na rang la sdig /nyon mongs rnam rtog ched du mi dgag cing*/ /ye shes bzang rdzu logs nas mi 'tshol bar//spang gnyen ro mnyam ngo bo tha dad med/ /gdod ma'i dbyings las logs su ma grub pas/ /mnyam nyid ngang der mnyam par bzhag par bya/ /rtsol med byar med klong du gyur pa na/ /spros pa'i snang ba ji ltar bstan na yang*/ /chu zla bzhin du las med bdag po med/ /gzugs sogs yul snang ji ltar shar na yang*/ /rang bzhin gnyug ma'i don las ma 'das pas/ /de la bzo bcos mi dgos lhug par zhog /nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur ba med pa yin/ /lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa ci byed dang*/ /spros bcas nyams len ji ltar byed na yang*/ /thams cad gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /rang 'od tsam du shes pa'i ngang du spyod/ /mtshan ldan bla ma rang sems snang ba tsam/ /bla ma rang bzhin gsal stong skye 'gag med/ /rang gi sems kyang de dang gcig par shes/

/snang ba thams cad sems kyi gzugs brnyan tsam/ /rang sems bla ma snang ba rnam gsum po/ /ming 'dogs tha dad don la khyad par med/ /thams cad ro mnyam nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ /chos skur rtogs na mos gus tshud pa lags/ /kun rdzob snang bar mdzad spyod ci mdzad kyang*/ /rang snang tsam du chos sku'i rnam rol dang*/ /gzhan snang sems can 'khor bar 'dren pa'i thabs/ kho nar mthong tshe mos gus tshad du phyin/ /ci mdzad ye shes rol par mthong ba la/ /bla ma longs skur mthong ba'i mos gus zer/ /legs nyes gang mdzad gzhan don kho nar shes/ /mtshan ldan bla ma sprul skur mthong ba yin/ /bla ma rang sems dbyer med chos skur mthong*/ /gnas lugs don gyi rtogs pa 'gyur ba med/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku'i mos gus skye/ /'bad med gzhan don phrin las 'byung zhes gsungs/ /sgom pas nyams su blang tshul mdo tsam mo/ /lta sgom mtha' ru phyin byed spyod pa ste/ /lag len blang dor 'khrul pa med pa gces/ /dkar nag las 'bras bslu ba med mod kyi/ /sgyu ma lta bur snang ba rang bzhin med/ /sdig spong dge ba sgrub dang dbu ma'i lam/ /ci byed gzhan don sgyur dang dus kun tu/ /dag snang lha sku stong nyid dang 'brel ba/ /gdod ma'i dbyings las g.yel ba med par spyod/ /de ltar gnas bdun rnam dag spyod pa lags/ /mi dge rgyu 'bras gdod nas stong nyid du/ /legs par rtogs pa'i sgo nas spang pa dang*/ /nyin mtshan phyed par dge la 'bad byed kyang*/ /chu zla bzhin du nga rgyal rlom sems med/ /'dod yon gang la'ang zhen pa spangs byas nas/ /tshogs kyis mi sgrub kun spangs spyod pa can//chos bzhin 'bad pa med par rnyed gyur na/ /rang sems snying por 'jog bzhin longs spyod pa/ /'dod pa'i mtha' dang ngal zhing dub pa ste/ /mtha' gnyis spangs pa dbu ma'i lam zhes gsungs/ /'dod chung chog shes ldan pa'i sgo nas kyang*/

/'di ltar bsgrubs na spyod pa rnam par dag /bya ba ci byed legs nyes ci byung yang*/ /byang chub sems kyis zin na gzhan don yin/ /thun dang thun mtshams spyod lam thams cad du/ /snang srid dag snang lha sku'i lam khyer bya/ /ji ltar spyod pa thams cad rang gi sems/ /sems nyid ngos bzung bral ba dgag sgrub med/ /bya ba thams cad byas stong ngang du thim/ /stong pa'i ngang las spyod pa'i rtsa ma 'gags/ /rang ngo shes tshe spyod pa ci spyad kyang*/ /bya byed ro mnyam dbyer med gdod ma'i gshis/ /dbyings las gzhan du 'pho 'gyur med pa la/ /rtsol med lhun grub thob par bya phyir 'bad/ /lta sgom spyod gsum rnam dag la 'bad na/ /'bras bu mchog la som nyi ga la yod/ /lam lnga sa bcu'i rim pa mngon gyur nas/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas tshe 'dir byang chub 'grub/ / rang bzhin 'gyur med sku gsum dang*/ /glo bur ma yin rgyun chad med//bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi gnas/ /'bras bu 'grub pa'i gnad bdun yin/ /thog ma med pa'i dus kyi dbyings/ /shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs te//rtogs shing gtan la phebs pa la/ /'bras bu thob par ming du btags//sangs rgyas zhes bya bzang bzang po/ /legs nas byung ba ma yin te//gzhi yi gnas lugs 'gyur med de/ /rang gis rang sa zin pa lags//stong pa'i rang bzhin chos kyi sku/ /gsal ba'i rang bzhin longs spyod rdzogs/ /bya byed snang ba sprul pa'i sku/ /sems nyid gcig pu sku gsum dngos/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas yon tan kun/ /sems kyi rang snang ma 'gags pa'i/ /rtsal yin rkyen las byung ba min/ /dus gsum snang ba 'khrul pa'i chos/ /don la 'das dang ma 'ongs med/ /rang bzhin ngos gzung med pa la/ /skye 'gag rgyun chad ga la yod/ / 'bras bu'i ye shes bsam yas phyir/ /tshig dang brjod pa'i yul las 'das/ / rnam rtog blo yis gzhal du med/ /bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i yul las 'das/

/ gdod nas dmigs gtad med pa la/ /re dogs bya sa ma rnyed pas//zhen med 'bad med brtson 'grus kyis/ /'bras bu klongs su 'gyur bar 'tshal/ /gdod ma'i rang bzhin nyams myong gis/ /gtan la 'bebs tshe tshogs kyi lam/ /chod nas sbyor lam skyes par shes/ /rtsa bral mngon gyur mthong ba'i lam/ /de nas rtogs pa'i rang ngo la/ /gsar du skyed bogs dbyung rgyu med/ /me long ye shes snang ba'i rtsal/ /'gag med phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i phyir/ /phyi nang spyod pa legs spyad pas/ /sgrib gnyis rtsad nas dag pa'i tshe/ /'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zer/ /de 'dra'i nyams len rim pa ni/ /'du 'dzi spangs te dben pa'i gnas/ /bsten zhing bsam gtan dang mthun pa'i/ /yo byad cung zad la brten te/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhal lung bzhin/ /man ngag rtse gcig nyams su blang*/ /lus ngag 'du 'dzis dben pa dang*/ /sems ni tha mal rtog pas dben/ /rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i mi lus thob dus 'dir/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba 'khrul pa'i 'khor lo la/ /nges par 'byung zhing mtha' yas sems can rnams//rang gi sems la rang nyid 'khrul mthong nas/ /'gro kun 'khrul pa'i rang 'tshang bshig pa'i phyir/ /bla med byang chub mchog la 'dun pa bskyed/ /thun mgor nges 'byung skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsgom/ /'jug tu yang yang bsngo bas rgyas 'debs gces/ /dngos gzhi'i nyams len zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis/ /spyod pa phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ /thun mtshams phyag mchod la sogs yan lag bdun/ khyad par bdag gzhan brje ba'i nyams len gces//'di dag pha rol phyin pa'i nyams len yin/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po'i bcud/ /gzhan yang gsang sngags thun mong min pa'i lam/ /'bras bu lam du byed pa'i gnad mchog ni/ /sems kyi rang rtsal 'gags pa med pa la/ /gzugs sku'i snang ba 'char ba'i nus pa yod/ /gzhi 'bras gnyis dang mthun par bskyed rim bsgom/

/bsgoms pas ma dag snang ba dbyings su 'dag rang bzhin bde stong kun gzhi'i ngo bo las/ /chos sku'i gnas lugs logs su med pa'i phyir/ /gzhi 'bras gnyis dang mthun par rdzogs rim lam//bde stong dbyer med bsgoms pas chos sku 'grub/ /sems la 'khrul pa'i bag chags bzhi yod pas/ /lus la 'khor lo bzhi yi rtsa khams chags/ /de las gnas skabs bzhi yi 'khrul snang 'byung*/ /de rnams gnad kyis zin na sku bzhi'i rgyu/ /snying gar gnyid 'thug rmongs pa'i 'khrul pa 'char/ /gnas der 'od gsal phyag rgya che bsgoms pas/ /spros kun nye bar zhi ba'i chos sku 'grub//gzhi lam 'bras gsum rtog med dbyings su mthun/ /mgrin pas rmi lam bar do'i gsal snang 'char/ /rmi lam lha sku'i lam khyer mgrin pa'i gnad//'bras bu longs sku'i dag snang rab 'byams 'byung*/ /'di gsum gsal snang phra mo rang bzhin gcig /sad dus 'khrul snang rags pa lte ba'i mthu/ /sgyu lus lha sku bden med gnad kyang de/ /sna tshogs sprul pas don byed sprul sku 'bras/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum rags pa'i snang bar mthun/ /'gyur ba'i bde ba spyi bo'i gnad las 'byung*/ /gtum mo'am las rgya gnad du bsnun pa'ang te/ /'bras bu 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i sku/ /gzhi lam 'bras gsum bde ba'i ngo bor mthun/ /sems ni rang bzhin stong dang gsal ba dang*//gsal ba'i rang gdangs sna tshogs 'char ba dang*/ /rang bzhin bde ba chen por gnas pa lags/ /rang ngo ma shes 'khrul pa'i gnas skabs bzhi/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs mngon gyur sku bzhi yin/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam gyi/ /gnad kyi snying po bsdus pa'ang de tsam ste/ /zab don bdud rtsis rang sems tshim par mdzod/ /de ltar mdo sngags lam gyi gdams pa 'di/ /skal ldan khyed kyi thugs la rab 'phrod nas/ /dpag yas 'gro rnams byang chub la 'god pa'i/ /thabs bzang mchog gis smin zhing grol byed shog

/'di dag nyams myong du ma dang 'brel mod kyi/ /rang bzos sbyar ba ma yin te/ /snying po logs nas mi btsal ba'i/ /lta ba ma bcos lhug pa ni/ /rgyal ba ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdor//gzugs kyi rang bzhin gzhan yin la/ /stong nyid gzhan du ma gsungs so/ /gang gis gzugs rnams rab shes pa/ /des na stong pa rab tu shes//gang gis stong nyid rab shes pas/ /des ni mya ngan 'das pa shes/ /rnam pa 'dis ni mi shes pa'i/ /dmigs pa can rnams rab tu rlag /ces gsungs lang gar gshegs mdo las/ /'jig rten skye 'jig ma mchis te/ /nam mkha'i me tog rab tu 'dra/ khyod kyis yod dang med ma dmigs/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gzung 'dzin med cing gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes yod dang rnam shes med/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ni/ /las dang spyod pa kun 'dra bar/ /rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas las byed pa/ /sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa/ /zhes gsungs bram ze chen pos kyang*/ /ji srid sems las rnam 'phros pa/ /de srid mgon po'i rang bzhin te/ /chu dang rlabs dag gzhan yin nam/ /nyams len sgom ni sambu ṭir/ /stong pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /stong min bsgom par mi bya'o/ /stong pa mi spang rnal 'byor pas//stong min yongs su mi spang ngo*/ /sems la sku gnyis tshang tshul ni/ /dgyes pa rdo rje'i rtsa rgyud las/ /zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs can te/ / mchog tu bde ba gzugs med pa/ /de phyir 'gro kun lhan cig skyes/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /ces gsungs sku bzhi'i 'brel rtsi ba/ /skye gnas snying mgrin mgo bor yang*/ /sku gsum po ni rnam par gnas/ /zhes sogs rgyud du gsal bar gsungs/ /zhes pa ni sgrub pa mchog la nye bar gzhol pa/ slob ma'i don po byams pa rin chen gyis nye bar bskul nas/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas pho brang chen po sne'u gdong rtser sbyar ba'o//

//dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /zhal gdams rin chen 'phreng ba bzhugs/ kyai/ slob dpon du rang gi sems 'di bzang*/ /lam sna ru bla ma rje 'di bzang*/ /lta ba ru gang shar ngos 'dzin bzang*/ /sgom pa ru ma bcos so ma bzang*/ /ngan pa'i spyod pa 'di 'gos re sla/ khrel med kyi grogs 'di blau brid mkhas/ /dus ngan gyi mi 'di 'char kha rgod/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba 'di 'brid re rkyen/ /'dod yon dang zhen chags 'di 'dris kha yang*/ /rig pa rnam rtog 'di col re chung*/ /rang 'dod kyi btags pa 'di ma tshor ram/ /g.yang sar ltung ba 'di ma tshor ram/ /'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di ma tshor ram/ /da res lam sna cig ma zin na/ /gtan gyi rdog sna gcig 'dred de mchi/ /chos byed dgos snyam kyang re ba lus/ /tshe long med 'di don med kyi ngang du 'das/ /dus da res mdo med gcig mi 'byung ngam/ /rang 'dod kyi lcags su bcug nas kyang*/ /sdug bsngal sna dgu 'byung ba nyams re nga*/ /lag len med pa'i bshad pa de/ /cha med rgyus gtam sgrog pa 'dra/ /dgos dus phan pa mi gda' 'o/ /nyams myong med pa'i gdams ngag de/ /shog ril dpe ril gyi khur po yin/ /yi ge tsam la lus te mchi/ /thag [ chod ] grod med pa'i nyams rtsal de/ /spre'u shing khar rtse ba dang 'dra/ /zar zir mang la don go chung*/ /rang ngo shes pa'i rnam rtog de/ /rdzing bur rde'u skyur pa 'dra/ /yal yol med kyang rang bzhin gyi dang*/ /sems la mi phan pa'i bshad rlabs 'di/ kha sbyang mkhas pa'i 'phyon ma dang 'dra/ /zer tshod dang lag len 'jol nas thal/ /mi rtag 'khor ba'i gnas tshul la/ /yid brtan byed pa tsho dang 'khrul/ /de bas rmi lam gyi rgya yis thob/ /lus mi brtan myur du 'jig 'jig 'dra/ /sha rus kyi phung po 'di 'gyes 'gyes 'dra/ kha sna'i dbugs 'di 'chad 'chad 'dra/ /mnga' rigs dang phyogs ris 'di 'khrul 'khrul 'dra/ /pha tshan dang sde tshan 'dis slu slu 'dra/

/gnyen 'brel gyi gdung sems 'di 'jig 'jig 'dra/ /'khor g.yog 'di kun dang 'bral 'bral 'dra//sdug bsngal na tsha'i tshad 'di 'jig 'jig 'dra/ /rnag khrag gi rkyal bu 'di ral ral 'dra/ /sha khrag gi spe'u 'di 'gyel 'gyel 'dra/ /rma shu ba'i mkhar 'di 'jig 'jig 'dra/ /sbrang ma kun sbrang rtsi gsog gsog nas/ /dbyar sos kyi zla ba drug kyang thal/ /skad cig gcig la gzhan gyis 'don/ /bu gsag la ma dga' sgrub pa gyis/ /phyi ma ngan song gi 'then thag dang*/ /tshe 'dir yang yid brtan ma mchis pas/ /tha mal gyi gnyen la gtad pa med/ /bu gnyen gyi gtso bor bla ma bsten/ /thabs sna tshogs kyis btul kyang thul bar dka'/ /dgra btul bas rang nyid dmyal bar lhung*/ /blun po kun mdun ma'i 'chug lugs la/ /dgra phyi nas ma 'dul rang sems thul/ /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i gshegs shul de/ rtse gcig tu sgom pa yin lags kyang*/ /mi 'di kun tha snyad la dga' dga' 'dra/ /bu tha snyad la ma dga' rtse gcig bsgoms/ /don ni rtse gcig tu sgoms na che/ /gdams ngag kun gyi gtso bo de/ /zhen med dang bya btang 'di lags mod kyang*/ /mi 'di kun zang zing la dga' dga' 'dra/ /bu zang zing la ma dga' chos la 'bungs/ /so ma rang dgar skyong ba 'di/ /chos kun gyi dgongs pa yin lags kyang*/ /dmigs bcas la mi 'di dga' dga' 'dra/ /sems bcur thag ma gtong rang dgar zhog/nan tan gyis gtan la dbab rgyu ste/ /rang gi sems nyid yin pa la/ kha phyir lta la dga' ba 'di ya re cha/ /rang ngo la ltos dang skal ldan gyi bu/ /tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas 'grub pa ste/ /gsang sngags kyi zab lam yin lags kyang*/ /'di kun gyi blor mi shong ba gda'/ /bu zab mo'i chos la dag snang sbyongs/ /'khor 'das ngo bo ro gcig 'di/ /spros dang bral ba gcig yin pa la/ /blo byas sgom pa ni rgod re bro/ /bu gcer mthong ngo shes phyogs med du skyongs/

/yid ches kyi dad pa skyon med 'di/ /gdams ngag zab mo'i snod yin kyang*/ /rang blos rgyas bkab kyi pho tshod 'di 'khrul/ /bu dad pa ngo lkog med par sbyongs/ /mi rtag 'chi ba bsam pa 'di/ /chos kyi skul mar gda' ba la/ /'di kun gyi rna bar mi snyan pa gda'/ /snyan pa la ma sems don la ltos/ /chos nyams su blang ba'i 'bras bu de/ /rang sems thul ba gcig dgos pa la/ /chos phyir du 'thab mo 'ong ba zhig gda'/ /chos dang sems su 'dre ba gcig 'tshal/ /thos pa byas pa'i 'bras bu de/ /nyams su len pa cig yin pa la/ /sde rigs kyi ru dpon cig don du gnyer/ /bu kha drag la ma dga' nyams su long*/ /gdams ngag dpe ris kyi tshig tsam gyi/ /nyams myong med par slob mar 'khrid/ /long bas long khrid byed pa ma lags sam/ /dpe ris la ma lta bsgom pa cig 'tshal/ /ku re dang kyal ka'i phyir du yang*/ /sdig pa rngam po che gsog pa mthong*/ /bzang 'dzin gyi rlom sems che ba yang*/ /chos kyi tha ma sdig la skyel/ /chos mi nus zer nas skyur skyur ba/ /da res mi khom 'dug ces bzhag bzhag pa/ /long yod do snyam nas dor dor ba/ /nga gzhon nu yin snyam khengs khengs pa/ /bden mi bden the tshom zos zos pa/ /'chor rang mthong skyes nas bor bor ba/ /phyis byed dgos snyam nas lus lus pa/ /nga gzhan dbang thal zhes zer zer ba/ /thang chad par 'dug ces nyal nyal ba/ /rje mtshan ldan bla ma brjed brjed pa/ /rgyud yid gnyis kyi tsher mas gang gang ba/ /rtag mi thub pa'i gsar 'grogs byed byed pa/ /lkog mi thub tshul 'chos byed byed pa/ /sdig shes bzhin khyad du gsod gsod pa/ /chos brgyad kyi grwa zur rgyas rgyas pa/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma mjal dus su/ /yid gnyis dang log rtog byed byed pa/ /zab don gyi chos dang mjal ba la/ /g.yengs ma'i lam la lus lus pa/ /chos thams cad nyams len du byed rgyu la/ /theg pa la bzang ngan 'byed 'byed pa/

/chos la phyogs rigs su spyod spyod pa/ /da bla ma'i 'khrul ba mi rtog 'tshal/ /gzhan rgyud la pho tshod mi rgyag 'tshal/ /rang gi yon tan la mi rlom zhing*/ /gzhan gyi skyon la yang ma rtog cig /nga rgyal gyi ri rtse ma 'grim cig /snyems byed kyi zhags pas ma 'ching zhig /chos brgyad kyi smig sgyu 'dis slu slu 'dra/ /'dod yon 'dam la ma bying zhig kha lta'i g.yang la 'chor nyen gdog /las 'bras khyad du ma gsod cig / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yud tsam la/ /long yod kyi skabs cig med med 'dra/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma rin chen 'di/ /u dumba ra ltar dkon po cig lags/ dang ba khams gso nus pa gcig 'tshal/ /tshe 'di yi khengs grags la spyod mkhan nam/ /zog rgan gcig dang 'phrad nyen gdog/sems gnyug ma don gyi 'dug lugs la/ /lta rgyu med kyang byar cig 'tshal/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje la/ /phyogs rigs med pa gal re che/ /gzhi rang bzhin lhun gyi grub pa de/ /skye med du rtogs na chos sku yin/ /blo byas su shor na gol ba yin/ /rkyen gyi 'char sgo sna tshogs 'di/ /sprul sku lags pas rang sar zhog /thob bya ru bzang 'dzin ma byed cig /gdod ma'i rang bzhin zung 'jug de/ /gzhi rang sems longs spyod rdzogs pa yin/ /rkyen gyis ma bcos so mar zhog

/snang sems dbyer med du ma shar na/ /bde gsal mi rtog skyong bde yang*//'khor ba'i sgrub thabs cig lags pas phan mi gda'/ /longs spyod rnam g.yengs kyi rlung po yin/ /mnga' ris kun 'ja' tshon gyi ri mo yin/ /rang gzhan zhes btsal pas ma rnyed na/ /'gro don rang gang la gang gis byed/ /de tsam na snying rje'i gzhan don yong*/ /spu gri la sbrang rtsi chags pa bzhin/ /bde skyid la chags zhen mi 'tshal lo/ /dus re zhig mi tshe 'di la yang*/ /rang bas gzhon pa yang ji tsam zhig shi /mnyam pa dang rgan pa yang ji tsam rang 'das/ /de yang yang thugs bsam mdzad pa zhu/ /nyon mongs dang rnam rtog ci byung yang*/ /sems la blta ba 'di khe re che/ /rnam rtog dang sdig pa rang rlag la 'gro/ /lta ba dang sgom pa yengs thub dgos/ /spyod pa la so thub ngo lkog med/ /gdams ngag la rang byan chud pa zhu/ /chos kha phyir dang tshig phyir ma 'brang cig /mo rtsis kyi 'gro don ma skyong cig /phyogs gzung gi phan 'dog ma byed cig /nyon mongs rang yan la ma gtong cig /zhe 'dod kyi 'phrin las ma skyong cig /mig mthong gi mngon shes mi 'tshal lo/ /mnyam rjes med par sgoms shig ang*/ /bdud kyi zhags pas ga la zin/ /nga bzang gi mtho gnon mi bya zhing*/ /snying rje la khag gtang gi zhen chags sdang*/ /zur mgo ma rags gang dga' thong*/ /tshul khrims dang tshul 'chos nor nyen gda'/ /shugs 'byung gi spyod pa ngo mtshar che/ /'gro sdod bya brel ci byung yang*/ /yengs pa med na sgom chen yin/ /spros bral gyi lta ba bshad tsa na/ /lta ba nam mkha' lta bu lags//nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa yin/ /'khor ba myang 'das rang bzhin med/ /gnyis kar 'khrul ba'i chos su snang*/ /spang blang med pa'i don gcig rtogs/ /zhen med kyi bsgom pa bshad tsa na/ /sems dang snang ba rnam rtog gsum/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du thal/ /mnyam rjes ro gcig dmigs gtad bral/ /lta nyul rtsol ba mi dgos so/

/man ngag gi rgyal po dran pa yin//spyod pa shugs 'byung bshad tsam na/ /'dzin zhen med pa gu re yangs//phyogs med du spyod pa nyams re dga'/ /ngo lkog med pas 'tshang re chung*/ /bu chung bzhin du lhug par bzhag /bza' gtad dang bral ba smyon pa 'dra//blang dor med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs/ /las byas kyang byar med ngang du gda'/ /bsags kyang sogs par mi gda' 'o/ /'bras bu lhun grub bshad tsam na/ /bzo bcos med pa'i rang sems 'di/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs par gda'/ /bcos ma'i sangs rgyas 'khrul pa yin/ /sangs rgyas la re dogs mi 'tshal lo/ /bla ma chos skur ma mthong ba'i/ /mos gus de phyogs zhen zang ma lags/ /snying rje med pa'i stong rkyang de/ /chad lta zang ma cig ma lags sam/ /sems can la gnod kyang mi 'dzem pa'i/ /btsun tshugs de tshul 'chos ma lags sam/ /nye ring med pa ma byung na/ /phan sems byed pa 'dod zhen yin/ /zas gos la zhen pa je rgyas la/ /'dzin chags med ces ma zer cig/rgyu 'bras las la mi 'dzem na/ /thos sgom kun chu la pho ba lags/ /sems chos su song ba zhig ma byung na/ /man ngag kun tshig phyir lus pa lags/ /dam pa la skur ba 'debs snang na/ /phrag dog gi gdon gyis zin pa yin/ /rnam rtog chu bur du shes tsa na/ /rang grol gyi rnal 'byor zer ba yin/ /sems bcas bcos ma byed ma slad par/ /gsal sing nge ye re wal le ba/ /hrig ge zhog dang gsal gyis yong*/ /rtsol ba skyed dang sgrim par zhu/ /sems je dwangs 'phro tshul bye thud byed/ /sgom kho na la 'dod pa skyo bar gda'/ /rig pa 'di gang la yang ma reg par/ /rten med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa/ /phyi shun pa bshus pa bzhin du song*//ngo bo ma rnyed pa rnyed rgyu zhig de na gda'/ /ngo ma shes pa shes rgyu zhig de na gda'/ /sems spro la dwangs pa'i dus shig gda'/ /de nyams myong gi dang po ma lags sam/ /sems snang ba la btang yang mi 'gro na/

/nyams myong gnyis pa shar ba lags/ /'phral snang ba du ma shar na yang*/ /dbyings gdod ma'i sems su ro gcig pa/ /de yang rmi lam lta bur myong*/ /res 'phro ba tsug byed kyang rig stong gi ngang*/ /ngo bo lhan gyis bzhag tsa na/ /rnam rtog kun gar song cha med du thal/ /de myong ba'i rim pa gsum pa lags/ /phyi snang ba'i 'char sgo ji snyed dang*/ /nang nyon mongs rnam rtog shar tsam na/ /rig pa dang stong pa 'phrod pa 'dis/ /rang stong nyid du rjen ne 'char/ /de ka la ngo shes rgyun chad med//mnyam rjes med pa'i rnal 'byor zer/ /rtsa bral du shes pa ma lags sam/ /smra bsam brjod med dang blo 'das dang*/ /rang rig rang gsal zhes zer na yang*/ /go ba dang nyams kyi sgrog gis bcings/ /sems ro dang 'dra na sgom chen min//sems pa med kyang ngo shes can/ /nam mkha' lta bur dpangs mtho la/ /sa gzhi ltar mi g.yo rgya re che/ / mar me ltar gsal la shel ltar dengs/ /chu ltar ngang gi dwangs pa la/ /sgom dus re dogs med pa dang*/ /thun mtshams su had de lung ma bstan/ /brtson 'grus drag po cig skyed pa zhu/ /'jig rten chos kyi zhen pa ldog /spros pa rig pa'i cho 'phrul du gda'/ /rig pa gsal stong rjen ne ba/ / btang snyoms su ma lus pa dar zhig skyed/ /chos rang sar dag pa la nges shes skyed/ /rnam rtog la gnyen po mi dgos par/ /rang stongs su 'gro ba'i nges shes skyed/ /rtog dpyod kun zad cing sim mer gda'/ /nang du bltas na sing ngai ba/ /phyi ru bltas na yul le ba/ /don spyi dang ma 'dres nyams su long*/ /phrag dog dang chags sdang rang dgar dag /rnam rtog dang nyams dang rtogs pa gsum/ /dbyer med du ngo shes nam mkha' 'dra/ /ci yang ma yin 'du 'bral med/ /tha mal gyi shes pa gra ma chag /ma bsnan ma khri zur ma nyams//thams cad sems kyi rang stsal la/ / bcos ma sgom tshad 'khrul pa yin/ /stong nyid kyi ngo bo sgom du med/

/nyams myong gi rtsi la ma zhen zhig /'on kyang byang sems dang 'bral ba med/ /mi gus pa yong la re ba dang*/ /brnyas pa byas na mi dga' ba/ /bstod na dga' la smad na sdug /rmi lam gyi bde ba la zhen pa 'di/ /rnyed bkur don gnyer du gda' bas na/ /skye bo phal pa dang khyad ci gdog /sgom chen gyi dri yang mi gda'o/ /kun rdzob dang don dam la nye ring med/ /stong pa de sgrub kyang mi dgos la/ /snang ba la bkag bya mi 'tshal lo/ /rig pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid de/ /bzang yang don spyi'i rgya ru chud/ /dmigs bcas kyi rnam gzhag mang lags kyang*/ /rnam rtog la yang la yang sings yin/ /mi chang gis bzi ba'i nyams bzhin nam/ /gzhon nu ma yi bde ba de/ /myong ma thag tu yal ba bzhin//thag chod med pa'i bde gsal de/ /na bun bzhin du snying po med//'gyur med kyi brtan sa cig zin pa 'tshal/ /'phral go chod las sna zin na yang*/ grwa rogs dang 'khor 'dabs kyi chags sdang gis/ /rang gzhan kun ngan par skyur nyen gda'/ /bu lon dang 'tsho 'tshis mi 'tshal la/ /'khor 'dabs spangs la ri khrod 'grims/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yang myur du 'jig /mi tshe 'di yang glo bur ba/ /glog dang zil ba bzhin shes pa zhig 'tshal/ /bya snyam 'di kun la yod mod kyang*/ /tshad tshad kyi ngang la mi tshe lus/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyod nus na/ /lto rgyab kun zhor la 'ong ba zhig gda'/ /rang gi dam tshig ma nyams na/ /mthun rkyen mkha' 'gros sgrub pa zhig gda'/ /long med kyi bsam pas kun bslangs nas/ /yengs med kyi sgrub pa gal re che/ /tshul bzhin du sgrubs na gdams ngag yin/ kha ltar shor na ku re mdzod/ /ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas slob ma 'ga' zhig la gdams pa ste g.yo ru gong dkar du'o// // ༄༅/ /'khor lo rin po che'i gtam bzhugs/ / oṃ swā sti/ bgrang yas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor las/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i 'od spro ba/ /bla med smra ba'i zla ba ni/

/bla ma sangs rgyas sras bcas 'dud//dran pa legs par mnyam bzhag na/ /de la shes bzhin ldan pa'i shes rab skyed/ /ting 'dzin sgo brgya ldan pa'i khang bzang mchog bgrod de/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan seng ge'i khri la myur du 'khod par 'gyur/ /dran nyams chos kun nyams pas de phyir dran pa rtag tu bsrung*/ /mi gtsang lus dang mtha' dag 'khor ba sdug bsngal te/ /'dus byas mi rtag chos kun bdag med ces/ /shes bzhin dran pa nye bar bzhag /'di na lam dang yon tan kun gyi gzhi/ /lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa dngos kun rang bzhin bcas/ /ji bzhin don la yengs med dran dang de'i/ /rigs dang mi rigs rnam dpyod shes bzhin bsten pa'o/ /dran pa gser bzang po lta bu'i gtam mo/ /'jig rten 'di na phun tshogs gang yin pa/ de dag gzhan la phan 'dod sems las byung*/ 'thab dang rtsod dang bcing dang brdeg /'gro la phan sems ldan la med/ /byang chub sems kyi sa bon las/ /dge ba'i sdong po rgyas gyur te/ /byang chub chen po'i 'bras bur smin gyur pa/ /dus mtha'i bar du sems can kun gyi nyer 'tsho byed/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yal 'dabs rnam rgyas pa//sngon med byang chub sems kyi dpag bsam shing chen te/ /gang blo nags kyi bdag po skrun 'di rmad/ /srid zhi'i ya mtshan dpag med rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur/ / gzhan phan gyi blo lte ba ltar brtan pa'i gtam mo/ /gang zhig dkon mchog gsum po la/ /gus pa'i sems kyis mchod bya ste/ /de las 'bras bu bde ba ni/ /bsam yas 'di dang phyi mar 'byung*/ /mngon du gyur dang ma gyur de bzhin gnyis ka dang*/ /mchod dang mchod par 'jug dang rang gzhan gnyis kas mchod/ /rnyed bkur de bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod dang rgya che dang*/ /nyon mongs can min zhes te mchod pa rnam pa bcu/ /yon tan bla med de bzhin phan thogs bla na med dang 'gro ba'i mchog gyur dang*/ /shin tu dkon dang 'ba' zhig mchog dang phun tshogs kun gyi gzhir gyur yin no zhes/

/gus pa'i bsam pa drug dang sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun phyag 'os zhes bya ba/ /mchod pa'i yul bzhis rab tu phye bas mchod pa de yang rnam pa brgyar 'gyur ro/ /rin chen lcags zangs ba glang rta/ /glang po bu mo yul 'khor dang*/ /'dod pa'i chung ma rang gi sha/ sbyin pa rnam pa bcu ru 'dod/ /chung dang 'bring dang chen po tshad med dang*/ /yul gyi khyad par mchog dman bar pa gsum/ /sems can byang chub gsum la 'god 'dod pa'i/ /bsam pa'i khyad par gsum ste sbyin pa brgya/ /mi dge'i las lam bcu po phyogs gcig spong dang gsal bar gzhan yang 'gog pa de bzhin thams cad spong*/ /dus kyang thung dang ring ba gzhan yang ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar dang bdag nyid spong dang spong 'jug dang*/ /yi rang bsngags pa brjod pas rnam par phye na nyes spyod sdom pa'i rang bzhin phyogs kyis bsgyur bas bcu/ /de bzhin legs byas rnam bcu mngon par bsgrub la legs par phye bas dge ba yang ni bcu phrag bcu/ /pha rol phyin pa rnam bcu po/ /re re'ang phyin drug bdag nyid can/ /rang gi mi mthun phyogs nyams shing*/ /'khor gsum mi dmigs ye shes ldan/ /phar phyin de dag gis kyang sems can kun/ /smin dang bsam pa rdzogs pa byed pas na/ /byang chub sems dpas rnam par spyad bya ba//stong pa nam mkha' zla ba'i grangs su 'gyur/ /dmyal gnas 'byung po byol song mi dang sbyin skyes yid bzang de bzhin gzugs kyi khams te 'di rnams la/ /nor lha yon tan mig dang rig byed rgya mtsho 'gro ba ri zla zhes bya rim bzhin grags su brjod/ /de dag gnas dang 'gro bas rnam phye gzhan ni gzugs med 'gro ba rnam bzhi de ltar srid pa gsum/ /brgya phrag 'jig rten de dag sems kyi snang ba tsam te me long dwangs pa'i gzugs brnyan gsal bar mtshungs/ /'di na sems kyi gsal ba tsam/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi snying po nyid/ /bag chags kyis ni rnam brtags pas/

/gnas don lus su snang ba byung*/ /sems nyid gcig pu 'khor ba dag dang lam/ /bde gshegs yon tan rnams kyi sa bon te/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba med las thams cad skyes/ /gnas skabs rnam gsum mngon par gsal bar snang*/ /sems kyi rang bzhin stong nyid de yang phyi nang stong sogs nyi shus rab phye ba/ /re re'ang gang zag med dang rang bzhin med cing phyogs re'i spros pas ma spros dang*/ /spros kun bral dang rang bzhin mi 'gyur rnam lngas phye bas don dam ming ni brgya phrag gcig /brjod dang rtogs pa'i tshul gyis rnam par dbye mod don dam dbyings la dbye ba med/ /sems kyi rang bzhin dug gsum dang*/ /kun ldang bag chags mthong spangs dang*/ /sgom spangs ma dag dag pa yi/ /dri ma rnam pa dgu las grol/ /rigs dang de bzhin nyid dang 'bras dbye bas/ /snying po rnam gsum glo bur dri ma dgus/ /nam yang ma gos 'di nyid sems can dang*/ /byang sems rgyal ba'i gnas skabs gsum dbye bas/ /rnam par phye dang bsam mi khyab gnas bzhi yang gnas skabs gsum gyis phye/ /rang bzhin dang ni rgyas pa'i rigs dbye snying po bstan pa'i dgos pa lnga/ /de lta na ni snying po'i mdo yang don gyi rab dbye brgya phrag gcig /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das phyir nan tan sgrubs pas 'bras bu smin 'gyur nyid/ /rang don don dam chos kyi sku/ /gzugs sku gzhan don brda' zhes bya/ /bral dang rnam par smin pa yin/ /yon tan mi zad rgya mtsho bzhin/ /rgyu skar bdag po 'od kyi dra ba can/ /sngo sangs 'dod ma'i dpal la mngon rol ba/ /rab dwangs padma'i mtsho la gzugs brnyan gyi/ /rnam bkra brgya phrag ri mo 'god par brtson//ye shes zla brnyan 'gro sems gtsang ma'i me long dag pa'i gzhi la rang shar gzugs kyi zlos gar mkhan/ /rtsol ba'i byed po drungs nas phyung yang sgyu ma lta bu'i sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'dren pa 'di ko mtshar/

/mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyi mdzes par spras shing byang chub phyogs chos de bzhin ma 'dres chos/ /cho 'phrul gsum ldan dbang dang stobs dang shes pa rnam bcu zhes pa rgyal ba'i yon tan brgya phrag gnyis/ /lam dang 'bras bu rtsibs stong gis nye bar mtshan pa lta bu'i gtam mo/ /gang zhig nyin rer rgyal ba rnams la rdul snyed kyi/ /zhing rnams rin chen bdun gyi bkang nas phul ba dang*/ /'bum phrag bskal par tshul khrims brtul zhugs mchog gnas dang*/ /gzhan ni ting 'dzin stobs kyis bde ba mngon sgrub pa/ /de yang mos pa'i dge bas zil gyis gnon zhes gsungs/ /gang phyir sbyin pas longs spyod khrims kyis mngon mtho dang*/ /ting 'dzin nyon mongs zhi bar byed pa tsam yin gyi/ /shes rab kyis ni nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib kun spong*/ /kun mkhyen 'gro ba 'dren par byed pa'ang shes rab 'bras/ /shes rab thos bsam sgom pa las byung de rnams kyang*/ /mos las byung phyir de phyir mos pa mchog yin pas/ /zab mo mos pa'i dge ba can gyi spyod yul lo/ /phan yon mu khyud bzang po lta bu'i gtam mo/ /dran pa rin chen gser las grub/ /lhag bsam phun tshogs lte ba brtan/ /lam dang 'bras bu rtsibs stong can/ /phan yon mu khyud rab mnyam pa/ /sngon med 'khor lo rin chen 'di/ /sa skyong mchog la skyes su 'bul/ / bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam rgyal nas/ /phyogs kun dge legs spel bar shog/

de skad tā ra nā thar mngon brjod pa/ /rig dang grol bar smra la mthu thob pas/ /nye bar sbyar ba 'dis kyang dam pa'i chos/ /yun ring gnas shing phyogs bcur dar bar shog/ // lo gsar du tshes pa la/ maṅgalaṃ/ /༈ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba spyan ldan la phyag 'tshal/ /yang dag lam la 'bad byas na/ /myang 'das thar pa ga la dka'/ /rnam dag lta ba 'bras bcas ldan/ /rim bzhin ji bzhin 'di nyid ni/ /lhun grub phul byung rdzu 'phrul 'byung*/ /ye shes gter chen ches mched de/ /mchog khyod 'gro don gtso bo'i gtso/ /de ltar rgyal ba chos bcas la/ /yang dag btud nas yang dag lam/ /legs par bshad kyi legs par nyon/ /dam pa'i gtam ni rnyed par dka'/ /blo ldan rnams la bdog pa nor min te/ /gang zhig legs par spyod pa de nor mchog /'byor bcas rgyal srid yang yang thob 'gyur gyi/ /lugs bzang rigs par 'doms pa rgya lam na/ /'di na dad pa thog mar nor gyi mchog/ rjes su dran pa rnam drug phun tshogs ldan/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan de bzhin nyid gzigs pa/ /bdud bzhi bcom nas chos kun mngon par brnyes//mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs ldan sdug bsngal spang*/ /'khor ba rgyu bcas thugs su chud gyur pa/ /gang gang nyon mongs spyod pa de de 'dul/ le lo can bskul log zhugs rnal mar 'god/ /gdul dka' tshar gcod mi srun btang snyoms mdzad/ /nyan thos rang rgyal rnams kyi bla ma ste/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyi mgon/ /thugs rje chen po'i yon tan dran par 'tshal/ /nyin gsum de bzhin mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran de go tam sras/ / legs par rnal la legs par sad 'gyur zhes/ /'dren pa zas gtsang sras kyis bka' stsal to/ /chags sdang la sogs dri ma thag srings pas/ /thos la sogs pa thog mtha' bar du dge /'phags lam yan lag rnam pa brgyad gang dag /byang chub gsum la yang dag bstod par byed/ /'gog pa so sor rang rig spyod yul can/

/lung rnams ma nor go sla gang zag gi /skyon dang ma 'dres lam ston don dang tshig /bsngags par 'os pa 'di ni dam pa'i chos/ /de phyir gus bcas chos la slab 'tshal gyi/ /gzhan gyi tshig sna gcod dang grags pa la/ /gtsor 'dzin legs bshad smra yang de dag ni/ /'jig rten rgyang phan bzhin du rnam par 'khyams/ /dge 'dun bslab gsum dag la mthun par zhugs/ /bslab gsum ldan phyir phyag mchod sbyin pa'i 'os/ /'phags min nyung ngur thos kyang tshul ldan la/ /srid gsum kun gyis phyag dang mchod par 'os//ser sna med dang rgyun mi chad dang gzhan/ /yon gnas gdam pa med pa'i sbyin pa las/ /longs spyod phun tshogs gang yang thob 'gyur bas/ /gtong ba'i yon tan dran pas lhag par spyod/ /tshul khrims 'chal ba'i dri spangs tshul 'chal gyi/ /rgyu bzhi las ni shin tu thag srings dang*/ /mi sdug la sogs gnyen po la brten dang*/ /myang 'das bsam pa la brten khrims kyi mchog /rang gi rigs kyi 'gro ba las lhag pa/ /'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs na spyod rnams kyi/ /lha rnams dag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ /bsam gtan la sogs bde ba'i yon tan bsam/ /de yi rgyu ni dge ba kho na ste/ /dge ba'i 'bras bu yang dag bsam par 'tshal/ /thog mar dang ba skyed de 'dun pa dang*/ /de nas yid ches dad pa skye bar 'gyur/ /dad pa yon tan kun gyi sa gzhi ste/ /'phags pa'i chos kun skyed byed ma yi mchog /'bras bu lo tog 'byin byed bdud rtsi'i char/ / nyes pa'i las la chu lon dam pa yin/ /tshul khrims rnam pa gsum la bslab par bya/ /mi dge'i lam bcu mi bgyid bgyid mi rtsal/ /yi rang spong dang mi bsngags mi smon zhing*/ /de bzhin dge ba bgyid pa la yang sbyar/ /thams cad 'gro la phan pa'i don du spyod/ /mchod 'os bslu dang gnas min 'gyod skyed dang*/ /rgyal sras la skur sems can bslu ba spangs/ /srung dang nongs pa 'chags la 'bad par 'tshal/

/mtho ris bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas tshul khrims te/ /thar pa'i grong du 'jug la them skas mchog /ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal rgyun gcod 'khor lo ste/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims bde ba'i lam/ / thar 'dod rnams kyi rna bar mi rtsub cing*/ /le lo can la sgyid lug mi skyed pa/ / 'phags pas rab bsngags bstan bcos las byung gtam/ /rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin mnyan par 'os pa nyid/ /thos pa gti mug rab rib sel ba'i sman/ / dam chos chu rgyun chad pa med par 'bab/ /'gro la snying brtse ldan pa'i lcags kyu ste/ /thos nas sgrub par byed pa'i don chen 'gyur/ /tshul khrims ldan dang 'phags dang drin che ba/ /sdug bsngal can dang bkur 'os mchod par mdzod/ / bzang dang gya nom mkho dgu ran pa dang*/ dus las ma yol sdig dang ma 'dres sbyin/ /mchod 'os mchod phyir srog dang nor 'phrog pa/ /da lta'i rgyal srid ngan pa'i ring lugs spang*/ /sbyin la dga' ba dang tshul rab rtsub kyang*//'phags dang myur du phrad nas thar par 'jug /bzod pa thob pas lus kyang gtong bar byed/ sbyin pas rang gi bsod nams 'phel ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i re skong yid bzhin nor bu yin/ /'di dang gzhan du longs spyod mchog gi rgyu/ /ngo tsha shes pa'i rgyan ni mchog tu mdzes/ /lha dang pha ma rgan rabs 'phags rnams kyis/ /bdag la khrel bar 'gyur zhes mi dge las/ /shin tu 'dzem pa'i mkhyen pa skyed par 'tshal/ khrel yod gos ni lha rdzas kun pas mchog /gzhan dag khyad du mi gsad bag ldan pas/ /'os pa ma yin bya ba ngan btang nas/ /dam pas bsngags pa'i spyod la dges par mdzod/ /thos pas tshig bzung bsam pa'i don nges nas/ /sgom pas dngos su shes rab bskyed par bya/ /ting 'dzin goms na shes rab 'phel 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar rlung nang mar me gsal mi 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin med na shes rab rnam par g.yo/ /shes rab mchog gis rnam par dpyod pa na/ /ting 'dzin gyis g.yogs yul ni gsal bar snang*/

/ji lta ji snyed gnas la rigs par dpyod/ /chos rnams ngo bos cung zad ma grub kyang*//'khor 'das rgyu 'bras 'brel ba mi bslu ba/ /zung 'jug 'di la mnyam par gzhag gyur na/ /srid pa'i 'ching las yongs su grol bar 'gyur/ /rjes dran mche ba drug ldan zhing*/ /'phags nor yan lag bdun gnas pa/ /chos kun theg pa cher 'jug ste/ /gtam 'di glang po rin po che/ /rig pa sa skyong khyod la 'bul/ /bla med rgyal srid mchog spyod pa'i/ /'khor lo sgyur ba'i gtso bo ru//rgya khyod dge legs brtan gyur cig /de skad smra ba dge slong tshul/ /tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas/ /mchog tu gshin pa'i sems kyis te/ /slar yang yang yang gsol bar bgyi// //dge'o//༈ oṃ swā sti/ skyabs gnas rin chen gsum la gus btud nas//rang gi sems la shar ba'i tshig 'di smra/ /dben pa'i ri bor mnyam bzhag byed do skad/ /gzhan gyi mig ngor pho tshugs bzang na yang*/ /brtags na sems dang chos su ma 'dres pa/ /'di 'dra dam chos gsha' ma ga la yin/ /da ni snying nas sgrub pa byed re ran/ /tshe 'di'i mdun ma skyungs dang snying med po/ /thos bsam lta rtog chos bshad rem na yang*/ /rkyen ngan bag re'i steng du dam chos 'dor//mkhas par grags kyang mi tshe stong zad mkhan/ /'di 'dra bshes gnyen dam pa ga la yin/ /da ni rang gi sems rgyud 'dul re ran/ /mdzub mo nang du khug dang snying med po/ /'khor ba'i gnas tshul 'phral 'phral mthong na yang*/ yid ches cung zad med pa'i tshod med po/ /pha rol 'gro tshe gdeng drod mi gda' na'ang*/ /bsam mno mi gtong smyon pa rgya yan mkhan/ /da ni phyi ma'i grabs shoms byed re ran/ /blo kha chos la bsgyur dang snying med po/ /mkhos ka 'di las med kyang chags sdang can/ /yon tan 'di la nga rgyal ri rab tsam/ /mgu mkhan su yang med kyang mthun 'jug mkhan/ /byas pa chung la re ba che ba khyod/ /da ni 'jig rten chos brgyad spong re ran/

/gang shar ro snyoms kyis dang snying med po/ /chos phyir gnyid thun re yang gcog mi nus/ /da lo da bzod byed snyam dang ring po/ /myong rtags 'phral la dgos pa'i stong yul can/ /zas nor snyan grags 'dod pa'i blo ma khugs/ /da ni mdun ma chig 'gril byed re ran/ /gting nas re dogs skyung dang snying med po/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas lang tsho yol zhing nyams/ /'khor 'dabs kun gyis phan lan gnod pas 'jal/ /da dung sun pa med pa'i blo rgya can/ /mi shes bzhin du tshe 'di'i mdun grabs byed/ /da ni snying nas bya btang byed re ran/ /phyogs med rang blo sbyongs dang snying med po/ /bla ma'i ming can rnams kyang chos mi byed/ /slob ma rnams kyang dam tshig srung mkhan med/ /skye bo kun kyang ngo tsha khrel gzhung med/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams pa'i dus ngan 'dir/ /gzhan la phan thabs ji tsam byas na yang*/ /phal cher mi phan rang la gnod par 'dug /rang nyid chos la brtan pa thob phan chad/ /gzhan don rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bas na/ /re zhig tshe 'di khong la gcags pa yi/ /gzhan don ltar snang bor la rang don mchog/dam pa'i chos la sgril ba'i dus su gda'/ /de ltar lags pas da dung bsam mno thong*/ /zhes rang la bskul pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas bsam sdings su rang lo nyer gsum pa la'o// //maṅgalaṃ// //༈ rang gi rtogs pa'i glu dbyangs so/ /༈ oṃ swā sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skyabs 'gran zla med pa'i bla ma rje/ /mtshan thos pa tsam gyis don mchog ldan/ /yid gus pas snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag mos pa'i bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /chos kyi rtsa ba rnam pa gsum/ /mtshan ldan bla mar mos gus dang*/ /snying rje byang chub sems sgom dang*/ /dmigs med rang bzhin sgom pa'o/ /dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa dang*/ /mi rtag 'chi bar bsam par bya/ /tshe 'di don gnyer zlog par 'gyur/ /skyes bu chung ngu'i nyams len yin/

/las 'bras slu med nges byas nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam par bya/ /thar pa don gnyer skye bar 'gyur/ /skyes bu 'bring gi nyams len yin/ /byang chub sems gnyis bsgom par bya/ /theg pa dman dang mtshan 'dzin bzlog /skyes bu chen po'i nyams len yin/ /snang ba snang stong lha sku dang*/ /sems nyid bde chen 'od gsal sgom/ 'di ni sngags kyi nyams len yin/ /snyigs dus ngan pa 'di lta bur/ /bshes gnyen dam pa shin tu dkon/ /chos par rdzus nas 'khor g.yog dang*/ /nor dang longs spyod bsdud pa mthong*/ /bsdus nas rang phyogs 'dzin pa dang*/ / gzhan phyogs smod pa'i rgyud ngan po/ /grags 'dod bya btang byed pa dang*/ / spyod pa gang bde'i gsang sngags pa/ /bzang 'dzin smra ba gtsor byed dang*//lo 'dod lha khang bzheng pa dang*/ /mkhas 'dod 'chad nyan byed pa dang*/ /mdzes chos tsam gyi btsun tshugs sogs/ /chos byed rnam dag yin re kan/ /rang bde'i dbang thang sgrub pa'i phyir/ /dus 'khrug gtum pa'i bzang rdzus mkhan/ /chos ni kha skad tsam yang med/ /tshe 'di'i mdun gros 'ba' zhig skyong*/ /rang la brten pa'i 'khor kun yang*/ /tshe 'di'i mnga' thang tsam la sbyor/ /sa gos bzang po'i dbus shig na/ /dpung dgung dang bu rta'i lang long can/ /'chi dus rang sems 'gyod na yang*/ /da dung gzhan gyi mgo skor la/ /rdzun gyi rbad kham chen po gtong*/ /de 'dra'i bla ma spang bar 'tshal/ /dang por bla ma bsten pa'i dus/ /ci byung gis chog shes mi byed par/ /chos bzhin ston pa bla mar bsten/ /dus lan gcig bla mar bsten grub nas/ /mdzad spyod ston lugs ci 'dra yang*/ /sangs rgyas dngos su thag gcod 'tshal/ /rang dbang bskur thob gdams ngag zhus/ /rgyud sde zab mo zhus pa yi/ /bla ma la mos gus gsol ba thob/ /mchog gi dngos grub de la 'byung*/ khong bla ma mang yang gcig tu sgoms/ /de sangs rgyas sems can gang ltar rung*/

/mdzad spyod dang mkhyen pa ci 'dra yang*/ /yid snyems 'khrig med pas gsol ba thob/ /yang rdo rje 'chang la yid smon dang*/ /brgyud pa'i che ba brjod brjod nas/ khong rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ /mi ru bzung na gnad nas 'chug /mtho gtong dma' gtong khyed rang shes/ /yid the tshom 'khu 'khrig ming yang med/ /sems gtad med mos gus wal le bas/ /rang shar rang der cham me zhog /'gro drug sems can thams cad kun/ /drin can gyis pha mar ma gyur med/ /rang nyid bde skyid 'dod 'dod nas/ /pha ma skyur ba'i mi ngan po/ /spyod pa dul zhing sems zhi yang*/ /mi phal pa bas kyang khrel bor bas/ /sems can bde 'dod kyi byams pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal bral 'dod kyi snying rje sgoms/ /de sems pa tsam la ma bzhag par/ /lag tu longs pa gal re che/ /byang chub mchog la 'god 'dod pas/ /don sangs rgyas zer ba'i sgra bau che/ /rang bzhin med pa'i gnas lugs la/ /ci yang 'char ba snying rje'i ngang*/ /de sgrub rgyu med kyang sgrub par 'tshal/ /yongs gang snang dmigs pa med pa'i ngang*/ /dag snang phyogs med rang shar gcig /mi bdag la dpal ldan bla mas bstan/ /de nyams su myong bas skyid gcig shar/ /bu khyod kyang 'di la bslab par mdzod/ /dran pa nyag gcig gi rnal 'byor la/ /skyes grol gyi 'char sgo ma gtogs pa/ /yul dang yul can gyi rjes kyang zhig /rnam rtog bcos ma'i grong khyer stongs/ /rtog dpyod kun sa mtshams de ru zad/ /gang shar ma bcos sgom du thal/ /ji ltar bcos kyang lhan ner gda'/ /'gyu ba 'gyu stong ngang du thim/ /mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi 'dun pa yal/ /gnas rgyu med pa'i rang gnas gcig /tha mal gyi rnam rtog skye thag chad/ /'char sgo la mi 'char bya ba med/ /gu yangs dang rgya 'byams kyi rnal 'byor zer/ /rtsa bral thag chod kyi sgom 'di la/ /spros bcas thams cad spros med kyi ngang*/ /mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen dbyer med du song*/

/nyon mongs dang ye shes spang blang bral/ /don 'di la gtad so thub par 'tshal/ /res 'ga' rig pa rten med du zhog /res 'ga' gang snang la cher re ltos/ /skabs re lta stangs nam mkhar gcun/ /res 'ga' sgrims la res 'ga' glod/ /res 'ga' dmigs pa rten bcas sgom/ /res 'ga' ma bcos so mar bzhag /res 'ga' rang sems yang yang tshol/ /nam zhig rtsa bral mngon du 'gyur/ /rkyen mos gus kho na gal re che/ /nyams nyi ma bzhin du 'char nub byed/ /don 'gyur med rtogs pa nam mkha' 'dra/ /go ba na bun bzhin du dengs/ /de yan chad phyag rgya chen po'i glu/ /de yi bogs 'don gal re che/ /gtum mo'i rnal 'byor bde ba'i lam/ /bden med sgyu lus lam gyi mchog /nyin mo'i rnal 'byor ngo mtshar che/ /snang grags lha sku'i dag snang la/ /zhu bde gtum mo'i 'bar 'dzag gis/ /dbu mar thim pa'i bde stong lam/ /lha sku gnyis snang spros dang bral/ /bden med sgyu ma'i 'dun pa sgom/ /sgyu mar 'dzin pa dbyings su chad/ /lam 'di sgoms dang rnal 'byor pa/ /bu 'di la 'bad dang snying gtam yin/ /mtshan mo gnyid log chos kyi sku/ /rlung sems dhū tir bcings pa na/ /gnyid kyi thim rim 'od gsal gyi ngang*/ /bde gsal stong pa 'gyur med sgom/ /rmi lam 'khrul pa'i bag chags 'di/ /'dun pas sbyangs nas lha skur bsgyur/ /phyogs med nyams kyi rtsa sbyangs pas/ /bar do zin pa ngo mtshar che/ khams gsum skad cig tsam la bsdu/ /stong pa'i ngang las lha skur ldang*/ /rlung sems snying gar ldang 'jug byed/ /'di sku gsum sgrub na gnad du che/ /nyin par chos spyod 'phel bar bya/ /mtshan mo zab mo'i ting 'dzin sgom/ /nyin mtshan gnyis kyi bya ba yin/ /tho rangs snga dro gtum mo sgom/ /nyin par sgyu lus sgom par bya/ /phyi 'phred rmi lam srod kyi dus/ /gnyid kyi 'od gsal bsgom par bya/ /nam gung 'od gsal rmi lam sgom/

/gal te mnyam bzhag mi brtan na/ /spraus bcas chos spyod 'bad nas sgrubs/ /lha sgom sngags bzlas mchod pa bya/ /sā tsha gdab cing bskor ba dang*/ /phyag dang gsung rab klog pa ste/ /bdun po de dag 'bad nas sgrub/ /sad ma thag tu dad pa sgom/ /de bzhin snying rje drag tu sgom/ /bstod pa gsol 'debs phyag mchod bya/ /ltung ba bshags shing slar yang bsdam/ /gtor ma btang ba la sogs bya/ /bzlas pa la sogs thun la 'bad/ /yan lag bdun pa ci nus bya/ khyad par smon lam mang du gdab/ / thun mtshams gsung rab lta bar bya/ /bya ba kun la dran shes bsten/ /rang gi rgyud kyi nyes pa brtag /de ltar thun mtshams kun la sbyar/ /zas kyang chos dang mthun par spyad/ /rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa dang*/ /gzhan snang zil gyis gnon nus shing*/ /dgos pa du ma mthong gyur na/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa ngo mtshar yang*/ /bu khyod de ltar ma gyur par/ /spyod pa gzab pa gnad du che/ /yi dam lha dang bla ma la/ /gsol ba btab cing gdam ngag zhu/ /dngos su mthong ba'i skal med na/ /rmi lam yul snang gtan la phab/ /dga' ldan mngon dga' bde ba can/ /gru 'dzin ri dang o rgyan dang*/ /ri bo rtse lnga la sogs su/ /rigs gsum mgon po'i lha tshogs la/ /zhal lta gdams ngag zhu bar bya/ /klad med gcam bu yal yul dang*/ /dam tshig skad cig mi bsrung pa'i/ /gsar 'grogs ngo dga'i bla ma dang*/ /chos sna mang yang gtad sa med/ /kun la yid brtan thub pa gces/ /'on kyang dag snang che bar bya/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas rang gi slob ma stan cig pa byams pa 'gro phan bzang po la gdams pa 'di yang ngam rings su ste rang gi rtogs pa'i glu dbyangs so// //maṅgalaṃ//༈ oṃ swa sti pra dzā bhyaḥ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dngos bla ma la/ /nam yang 'bral ba med pa'i gdung shugs kyi/ /gus pas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bu slob blo sna chos la sgyur du gsol/ /nges med spyod pa'i rnal 'byor rgyal khams pas/

/snyan bskul gtan gyi mdun grol 'bul ba ni/ /dam chos las gzhan mdun ma'i rgyal po ni/ /gzhan zhig yod med dpyod ldan rnams kyis dpyod/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid thams cad bslu ba'i chos/ /da lta 'di nyid dga' snyam sems 'brid kyang*/ /ring por mi thogs rang gi gnas tshul ston/ /'dod yon longs spyod dag la chags pa 'di/ /thog med dus nas ngan goms la song zhing*/ /da res rgyun du 'dris pas dbral bar dka'/ /rig pa spre'u ltar bcol chung rnam g.yeng che/ /las ngan thag pas btags pa ma tshor ram/ /da res thar pa'i gdog sna ma tshugs na/ /nges par ngan 'gro'i g.yang du 'dred nyen gda'/ /rkyen ngan bdo' dus nyams len med pa'i chos/ /bshad mkhas lag rdum g.yul du zhugs pa 'dra/ /tshig la mi dgyes don la nyams len 'tshal/ /sbrang ma sbrang rtsi sogs dang byi ba'i dpe/ /rang gis bsags pa'i longs spyod gzhan gyis za/ /snying po med la shin tu thugs 'byung bas/ /gsag la ma dgyes dge ba'i phyogs su thong*/ /zla drug dka' las khur ba'i zhing pa yang*/ /ston thog ma zos shi ba mthong ba'i tshe/ /las kun dka' la don re chung bar shes/ /las la ma dgyes ci mdzad chos la bsgyur/ /pha ma spun zla 'khor g.yog la ltas na/ /'ga' zhig sngar 'das la la da bzod 'gro/ /mi sdod 'bral ba mthong tshe yid re skyo/ /rang yang de ltar yin min bsam pa zhu/ /mdza' ba'i grogs kyang rmi lam mgron po 'dra/ /yod pa'i 'phro la gar song cha med 'gro/ /dpal 'byor 'di yang ston ka'i na bun 'dra/ /yun ring sdod sdod 'dra yang 'phral du 'jig /dbang thang longs spyod sos ka'i 'ja' tshon 'dra//mig sngar mdzes kyang yid brtan rtag mi thub/ /de la g.yo rgyu brdzun zob lhur blangs pa'i/ khe bogs nyes pa che bas rigs ma yin/ /da lta blo gtad 'cha' ba'i grogs po yang*/ /'phral du dgra yi dang mar 'gyur gyin snang*/ dgra gnyen mi rtag phyogs zhen mi 'tshal bas/

/gtan gyi dgra bo yin nges nyon mongs thul/ /bskyangs pa'i bu tsha rang stobs rgyas pa'i tshe/ /drin dang ldan pa'i pha mar ma gus shing*/ /cir yang mi sems mang du mthong bas na/ /dgos dus phan nges rig pa'i khye'u skyongs/ /mir skyes rtsa na sdig pa la dga' ba/ /shi nas gshin rje'i skyes bus khrid gyur te/ /bzod thabs med pa'i sdug bsngal bskal par myong*/ /dmyal bar skyes tshe 'gyod kyang ci la phan/ /nam zhig sha rus phung po 'jig pa dang*/ /'gyu ba'i dbugs 'chad gnyen gyi gdung sems 'jig/
